  // ─── React Query hooks ──────────────────────────────────────
  const { data: balances, isLoading: balancesLoading } = useBalances();
  const { data: ticker, isLoading: tickerLoading } = useTicker(selectedMarket);
  const placeOrder = usePlaceOrder();

  // ─── Local state for UI ────────────────────────────────────
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<"limit" | "market" | "marketstop" | "limitstop">(
    orderType === "market" ? "market" : "limit"
  );
  const [total, setTotal] = useState<string>("");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);

  // ─── Real balances ──────────────────────────────────────────
  const baseAsset = selectedMarket?.split("-")[0] || "BTC";
  const quoteAsset = selectedMarket?.split("-")[1] || "USDT";

  const baseBalance = balances?.find((b) => b.symbol === baseAsset);
  const quoteBalance = balances?.find((b) => b.symbol === quoteAsset);

  const availableBase = baseBalance ? parseFloat(baseBalance.available) : 0;
  const availableQuote = quoteBalance ? parseFloat(quoteBalance.available) : 0;

  // ─── Real market price ──────────────────────────────────────
  const marketPrice = ticker?.lastPrice ? parseFloat(ticker.lastPrice) : 0;

  // ─── Calculate total when amount or price changes ──────────
  useEffect(() => {
    const numAmount = parseFloat(amount) || 0;
    const numPrice = parseFloat(price) || marketPrice;
    if (numAmount > 0 && numPrice > 0) {
      setTotal((numAmount * numPrice).toFixed(2));
    } else {
      setTotal("");
    }
  }, [amount, price, marketPrice]);

  // ─── Max buttons ────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleMaxBuy = () => {
    const currentPrice = parseFloat(price) || marketPrice;
    if (currentPrice > 0) {
      const maxAmount = availableQuote / currentPrice;
      setAmount(maxAmount.toFixed(8));
    }
  };

  const handleMaxSell = () => {
    setAmount(availableBase.toFixed(8));
  };

  // ─── Fee estimation ─────────────────────────────────────────
  const feeRate = 0.001; // 0.1% – could be fetched from market config
  const estimatedFee = parseFloat(total) * feeRate || 0;




  const handlePlaceOrder = (side: "buy" | "sell") => {
    if (!selectedMarket) {
      setError("No market selected");
      return;
    }
    if (!amount || parseFloat(amount) <= 0) {
      setError("Invalid amount");
      return;
    }
    if (activeTab === "limit" && (!price || parseFloat(price) <= 0)) {
      setError("Invalid price for limit order");
      return;
    }

    setError(null);
    setIsSubmitting(true);


    let orderPrice: string | undefined;
  if (activeTab === "limit") {
    orderPrice = price;
  } else {
    // Market order – use current market price for margin calculation
    if (marketPrice > 0) {
      orderPrice = String(marketPrice);
    } else {
      setError("Market price not available");
      setIsSubmitting(false);
      return;
    }
  }

    const payload = {
      market: selectedMarket,
      side,
      orderType: activeTab === "market" ? "market" : "limit",
      quantity: amount,
      leverage: leverage || "1",
      price: orderPrice,
      timeInForce: "GTC",
      reduceOnly: false,
      postOnly: false,
    };

    placeOrder.mutate(payload, {
      onSuccess: (data) => {
        console.log("Order placed:", data);
        setAmount("");
        setPrice("");
        setTotal("");
        setIsSubmitting(false);
      },
      onError: (err: Error) => {
        setError(err.message || "Order failed");
        setIsSubmitting(false);
      },
    });
  };

  // ─── Tab change sync ────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleTabChange = (tab: "limit" | "market" | "stopLimit") => {
    setActiveTab(tab);
    setOrderType(tab === "market" ? "market" : "limit");
    setPrice("");
    setTotal("");
  };

  // ─── Render ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  return (
    <div className="w-full p-2 text-[#eaeef4] overflow-x-auto">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
        <span className="text-[9px] font-semibold text-[#eaeef4]">
          {selectedMarket || "Spot"}
        </span>
        <span className="text-[9px] text-[#8d93a0] bg-[#1a1f28] px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
          {leverage || "1"}×
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Tabs */}
      <div className="flex border-b text-[9px] border-[#1e232c] mb-2">
        {["Limit", "Market", "Stop Limit"].map((tab) => {
          const key = tab.toLowerCase().replace(" ", "") as "limit" | "market" | "stopLimit";
          return (
            <button
              key={tab}
              className={`px-2 py-1 text-[9px] transition-colors ${
                activeTab === key
                  ? "text-[#eaeef4] border-b-2 border-blue-500"
                  : "text-[#8d93a0] hover:text-[#eaeef4]"
              }`}
              onClick={() => handleTabChange(key)}
            >
              {tab}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* Price */}
      <div className="flex justify-evenly">
        <div className="mb-3 w-full max-w-[23rem]">
          <label className="block text-[9px] text-[#5e6573] uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
            Price
          </label>
          <div className="relative">
            <input
              type="text"
              className="w-full border border-[#232833] rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-[9px] text-[#eaeef4] outline-none focus:border-blue-500 transition-colors"
              placeholder={activeTab === "market" ? "Market Price" : "0.00"}
              value={activeTab === "market" ? (marketPrice ? marketPrice.toFixed(2) : "—") : price}
              onChange={(e) => {
                if (activeTab !== "market") setPrice(e.target.value);
              }}
              disabled={activeTab === "market"}
            />
            {activeTab === "market" && (
              <span className="absolute right-3 top-2 text-[9px] text-[#8d93a0]">Market</span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Amount */}
        <div className="mb-3 w-full max-w-[23rem]">
          <label className="block text-[9px] text-[#5e6573] uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
            Amount ({baseAsset})
          </label>
          <div className="relative">
            <input
              type="text"
              className="w-full border border-[#232833] rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-[9px] text-[#eaeef4] outline-none focus:border-blue-500 transition-colors"
              placeholder="0.00"
              value={amount}
              onChange={(e) => setAmount(e.target.value)}
            />
            <span className="absolute right-3 top-2 text-[9px] text-[#8d93a0]">{baseAsset}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex justify-between text-[9px] text-[#5e6573] mt-1">
            <span className="text-[9px]">Min: 5 {quoteAsset}</span>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <button onClick={handleMaxBuy} className="hover:text-[#eaeef4]">
                Max Buy
              </button>
              <button onClick={handleMaxSell} className="hover:text-[#eaeef4]">
                Max Sell
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Total & Balances */}
      <div className="flex justify-evenly">
        <div className="mb-3 w-full max-w-[43rem] flex justify-between ">
          <div className="w-[58%]">
            <label className="block text-[9px] text-[#5e6573] uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
            Total
          </label>
          <div className="relative">
            <input
              type="text"
              className="w-full border border-[#232833] rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-[9px] text-[#eaeef4] outline-none focus:border-blue-500 transition-colors"
              placeholder="0.00"
              value={total}
              readOnly
            />
            <span className="absolute right-3 top-2 text-[9px] text-[#8d93a0]">{quoteAsset}</span>
          </div>
          </div>
          <div className="w-[40%]">
          <label className="block text-[9px] text-[#5e6573] uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
            Tp sL
          </label>
          <div className="relative">
            <input
              type="text"
              className="w-full border border-[#232833] rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-[9px] text-[#eaeef4] outline-none focus:border-blue-500 transition-colors"
              placeholder="0.00"
              value={""}
              readOnly
            />
            <span className="absolute right-3 top-2 text-[9px] text-[#8d93a0]">{quoteAsset}</span>
          </div>
          </div>
        </div>


        <div className="flex gap-2 text-[#8d93a0] p-3 rounded-lg mt-3 justify-center items-center">
          <div className="flex items-center">
            <span className="text-[9px] mr-1">Avbl</span>
            <span className="block text-[#eaeef4] text-[9px]">
              {balancesLoading ? "…" : `${formatNumber(availableQuote)} ${quoteAsset}`}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center">
            <span className="text-[9px] mr-1">Avbl</span>
            <span className="block text-[#eaeef4] text-[9px]">
              {balancesLoading ? "…" : `${formatNumber(availableBase)} ${baseAsset}`}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Error */}
      {error && (
        <div className="text-[#f6465d] text-[9px] mb-2 text-center">{error}</div>
      )}

      {/* Est. Fee */}
      <div className="flex justify-between text-[9px] text-[#5e6573] mb-2 border-t border-[#1e232c] pt-2">
        <span>Est. Fee</span>
        <span className="text-[#eaeef4] font-mono">
          {estimatedFee > 0 ? `${estimatedFee.toFixed(4)} ${quoteAsset}` : "—"}
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Buy / Sell Buttons */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 h-[6vh]">
        <button
          className="bg-[#0ecb81] hover:bg-[#0cb873] text-white font-semibold py-2.5 rounded-sm transition-colors text-[9px] disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
          onClick={() => handlePlaceOrder("buy")}
          disabled={isSubmitting || placeOrder.isPending}
        >
          {placeOrder.isPending ? "Placing…" : `Buy ${baseAsset}`}
        </button>
        <button
          className="bg-[#f6465d] hover:bg-[#d93a4f] text-white font-semibold py-2.5 rounded-sm transition-colors text-[9px] disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
          onClick={() => handlePlaceOrder("sell")}
          disabled={isSubmitting || placeOrder.isPending}
        >
          {placeOrder.isPending ? "Placing…" : `Sell ${baseAsset}`}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="terminal/components/OrderTables.tsx">
"use client";

import { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import {
  usePositions,
  useOrders,
  useFills,
  useCancelOrder,
  useClosePosition,
  useMarkets,
} from "@/hooks/useMarketData";
import { useAuth } from "@/hooks/useAuth";
import { Button, StatusPill, EmptyState, LoadingRow } from "./ui";
import { formatPrice, formatNumber, formatTime, formatUsd, clsx } from "@/lib/utils";

type Tab = "positions" | "open" | "history" | "fills";

export function OrderTables() {
  const { isAuthenticated } = useAuth();
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<Tab>("positions");
  const { data: positions, isLoading: loadingPositions } = usePositions("open");
  const { data: openOrders, isLoading: loadingOpen } = useOrders({ status: "open" });
  const { data: history, isLoading: loadingHistory } = useOrders({ limit: 50 });
  const { data: fills, isLoading: loadingFills } = useFills(50);
  const cancelOrder = useCancelOrder();
  const closePosition = useClosePosition();

  const { data: markets } = useMarkets();
  const symbolOf = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, string>();
    for (const m of markets ?? []) map.set(m.id, m.symbol);
    return (id: string) => map.get(id) ?? id;
  }, [markets]);

  const tabs: Array<{ id: Tab; label: string; count?: number }> = [
    { id: "positions", label: "Positions", count: positions?.length },
    { id: "open", label: "Open Orders", count: openOrders?.length },
    { id: "history", label: "Order History", count: history?.length },
    { id: "fills", label: "Trade History", count: fills?.length },
  ];

  if (!isAuthenticated) {
    return (
      <div className="border-t border-border bg-card p-6 text-center text-sm text-text-secondary">
        <p className="mb-3">Log in to view your positions, orders and trade history.</p>
        <a href="/login" className="rounded-md bg-primary px-4 py-2 font-semibold text-black">
          Log in
        </a>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const loadingMap: Record<Tab, boolean> = {
    positions: loadingPositions,
    open: loadingOpen,
    history: loadingHistory,
    fills: loadingFills,
  };

  return (
    <div className="border-t border-border bg-card">
      <div className="flex gap-1 overflow-x-auto border-b border-border px-2">
        {tabs.map((t) => (
          <button
            key={t.id}
            onClick={() => setTab(t.id)}
            className={clsx(
              "shrink-0 border-b-2 px-4 py-3 text-sm transition-colors",
              tab === t.id
                ? "border-primary font-semibold text-primary"
                : "border-transparent text-text-secondary hover:text-text-primary"
            )}
          >
            {t.label}
            {t.count !== undefined && t.count > 0 && (
              <span className="ml-1.5 rounded bg-card-hover px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs text-text-secondary">
                {t.count}
              </span>
            )}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="overflow-x-auto">
        {loadingMap[tab] ? (
          <LoadingRow />
        ) : tab === "positions" ? (
          <PositionsTable
            positions={positions ?? []}
            symbolOf={symbolOf}
            onClose={(id) => closePosition.mutate(id)}
          />
        ) : tab === "open" ? (
          <OrdersList orders={openOrders ?? []} symbolOf={symbolOf} onCancel={(id) => cancelOrder.mutate(id)} />
        ) : tab === "history" ? (
          <OrdersList orders={history ?? []} symbolOf={symbolOf} />
        ) : (
          <FillsTable fills={fills ?? []} symbolOf={symbolOf} />
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function PositionsTable({
  positions,
  symbolOf,
  onClose,
}: {
  positions: Array<{
    id: string;
    marketId: string;
    side: string;
    quantity: string;
    entryPrice: string;
    markPrice: string;
    liquidationPrice: string;
    margin: string;
    leverage: number;
    realizedPnl: string;
  }>;
  symbolOf: (id: string) => string;
  onClose: (id: string) => void;
}) {
  if (!positions.length) {
    return <EmptyState title="No open positions" hint="Place an order to open a position." />;
  }
  return (
    <table className="w-full min-w-[800px] text-sm">
      <thead>
        <tr className="border-b border-border text-left text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-text-secondary">
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Market</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Side</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Size</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Entry Price</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Mark Price</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Liq. Price</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Margin</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Leverage</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">PnL</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-medium">Action</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        {positions.map((p) => {
          const long = p.side === "long";
          const pnl = (Number(p.markPrice) - Number(p.entryPrice)) * Number(p.quantity) * (long ? 1 : -1);
          return (
            <tr key={p.id} className="border-b border-border hover:bg-card-hover">
              <td className="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-text-primary">
                {symbolOf(p.marketId).split("-")[0]}/USDT
              </td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3">
                <span className={long ? "text-profit" : "text-loss"}>
                  {long ? "Long" : "Short"}
                </span>
              </td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-primary">{formatNumber(p.quantity)}</td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-primary">{formatPrice(p.entryPrice)}</td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-primary">{formatPrice(p.markPrice)}</td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-primary">{formatPrice(p.liquidationPrice)}</td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-primary">{formatUsd(p.margin)}</td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-primary">{p.leverage}×</td>
              <td className={clsx("px-4 py-3", pnl >= 0 ? "text-profit" : "text-loss")}>
                {formatUsd(pnl)}
              </td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                <Button variant="sell" className="px-3 py-1 text-xs" onClick={() => onClose(p.id)}>
                  Close
                </Button>
              </td>
            </tr>
          );
        })}
      </tbody>
    </table>
  );
}

function OrdersList({
  orders,
  symbolOf,
  onCancel,
}: {
  orders: Array<{
    id: string;
    marketId: string;
    side: string;
    orderType: string;
    price: string | null;
    quantity: string;
    filledQuantity: string;
    status: string;
    createdAt: string;
  }>;
  symbolOf: (id: string) => string;
  onCancel?: (id: string) => void;
}) {
  if (!orders.length) {
    return <EmptyState title="No orders" hint="Your orders will appear here." />;
  }
  return (
    <table className="w-full min-w-[800px] text-sm">
      <thead>
        <tr className="border-b border-border text-left text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-text-secondary">
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Market</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Side</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Type</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Price</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Qty</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Filled</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Status</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Time</th>
          {onCancel && <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-medium">Action</th>}
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        {orders.map((o) => {
          const buy = o.side === "buy";
          return (
            <tr key={o.id} className="border-b border-border hover:bg-card-hover">
              <td className="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-text-primary">
                {symbolOf(o.marketId).split("-")[0]}/USDT
              </td>
              <td className={buy ? "px-4 py-3 text-profit" : "px-4 py-3 text-loss"}>
                {buy ? "Buy" : "Sell"}
              </td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 capitalize text-text-primary">{o.orderType}</td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-primary">{o.price ? formatPrice(o.price) : "Market"}</td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-primary">{formatNumber(o.quantity)}</td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-secondary">{formatNumber(o.filledQuantity)}</td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3">
                <StatusPill status={o.status} />
              </td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-secondary">{formatTime(o.createdAt)}</td>
              {onCancel && (
                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                  <Button variant="outline" className="px-3 py-1 text-xs" onClick={() => onCancel(o.id)}>
                    Cancel
                  </Button>
                </td>
              )}
            </tr>
          );
        })}
      </tbody>
    </table>
  );
}

function FillsTable({
  fills,
  symbolOf,
}: {
  fills: Array<{
    id: string;
    marketId: string;
    side: string;
    price: string;
    quantity: string;
    makerFee: string;
    takerFee: string;
    createdAt: string;
  }>;
  symbolOf: (id: string) => string;
}) {
  if (!fills.length) {
    return <EmptyState title="No trades yet" hint="Filled orders will show up here." />;
  }
  return (
    <table className="w-full min-w-[800px] text-sm">
      <thead>
        <tr className="border-b border-border text-left text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-text-secondary">
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Market</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Side</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Price</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Qty</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Fee</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Time</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        {fills.map((f) => {
          const buy = f.side === "buy";
          const fee = Number(f.makerFee) + Number(f.takerFee);
          return (
            <tr key={f.id} className="border-b border-border hover:bg-card-hover">
              <td className="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-text-primary">
                {symbolOf(f.marketId).split("-")[0]}/USDT
              </td>
              <td className={buy ? "px-4 py-3 text-profit" : "px-4 py-3 text-loss"}>
                {buy ? "Buy" : "Sell"}
              </td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-primary">{formatPrice(f.price)}</td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-primary">{formatNumber(f.quantity)}</td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-secondary">{formatUsd(fee)}</td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-secondary">{formatTime(f.createdAt)}</td>
            </tr>
          );
        })}
      </tbody>
    </table>
  );
}

<file path="terminal/components/PortfolioChart.tsx">
"use client";

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import * as echarts from "echarts";
import { useBalances } from "@/hooks/useMarketData";
import { useAuth } from "@/hooks/useAuth";

interface DataItem {
  name: string;
  value: [string, number];
}

export default function PortfolioChart() {
  const chartRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const chartInstance = useRef<echarts.ECharts | null>(null);
  const { isAuthenticated } = useAuth();
  const { data: balances, isLoading } = useBalances();

  const [history, setHistory] = useState<DataItem[]>([]);
  const [totalValue, setTotalValue] = useState<number>(0);

  // Calculate total portfolio value in USDT (simplified – assumes all assets have USDT price)
  const calculateTotalValue = (bals: any[]) => {
    if (!bals || bals.length === 0) return 0;
    let total = 0;
    for (const bal of bals) {
      // For USDT, value is just the balance itself
      if (bal.symbol === "USDT") {
        total += parseFloat(bal.available);
      } else {
        // For other assets, we'd need a price feed – for now, use a dummy price
        // In production, fetch prices from /ticker
        const dummyPrice = bal.symbol === "BTC" ? 60000 : bal.symbol === "ETH" ? 3000 : 100;
        total += parseFloat(bal.available) * dummyPrice;
      }
    }
    return total;
  };

  // Initialize history with some baseline data
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!balances || balances.length === 0) return;
    const now = new Date();
    const initialValue = calculateTotalValue(balances);
    setTotalValue(initialValue);

    // Seed with 50 data points (last 50 minutes or so)
    const seededData: DataItem[] = [];
    const startTime = new Date(now.getTime() - 50 * 60 * 1000);
    let value = initialValue * 0.9; // start slightly lower for visual effect
    for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
      const ts = new Date(startTime.getTime() + i * 60 * 1000);
      value = value + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 5;
      seededData.push({
        name: ts.toString(),
        value: [
          `${ts.getFullYear()}/${ts.getMonth() + 1}/${ts.getDate()} ${ts.getHours()}:${String(ts.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}`,
          Math.round(Math.max(value, 100)),
        ],
      });
    }
    setHistory(seededData);
  }, [balances]);

  // Update chart when history changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!chartRef.current) return;
    if (!chartInstance.current) {
      chartInstance.current = echarts.init(chartRef.current, "light");
    }

    const option: echarts.EChartsOption = {
      tooltip: {
        trigger: "axis",
        formatter: (params: any) => {
          const p = params[0];
          const date = new Date(p.name);
          return `${date.toLocaleDateString()} ${date.toLocaleTimeString()}<br/>Equity: $${p.value[1].toFixed(2)}`;
        },
        axisPointer: { animation: false },
      },
      grid: {
        left: "3%",
        right: "4%",
        bottom: "3%",
        top: "8%",
        containLabel: true,
      },
      xAxis: {
        type: "time",
        splitLine: { show: false },
        axisLabel: {
          formatter: (value: number) => {
            const date = new Date(value);
            return `${date.getHours()}:${String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
          },
        },
      },
      yAxis: {
        type: "value",
        splitLine: { show: true, lineStyle: { color: "#2b3139" } },
        axisLabel: {
          formatter: "$ {value}",
        },
      },
      series: [
        {
          name: "Portfolio Value",
          type: "line",
          showSymbol: false,
          smooth: true,
          lineStyle: {
            color: "#350bf0",
            width: 2,
          },
          areaStyle: {
            color: new echarts.graphic.LinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 1, [
              
            ]),
          },
          data: history,
        },
      ],
    };

    chartInstance.current.setOption(option);
    chartInstance.current.resize();

    return () => {
      chartInstance.current?.dispose();
      chartInstance.current = null;
    };
  }, [history]);

  // Update equity periodically (simulate real‑time updates)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isAuthenticated) return;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setHistory((prev) => {
        const now = new Date();
        const lastValue = prev.length > 0 ? prev[prev.length - 1].value[1] : 1000;
        // Simulate small random movement
        const change = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10;
        const newValue = Math.round(Math.max(lastValue + change, 100));

        // Remove oldest if we have more than 500 points
        const newData = prev.length > 500 ? prev.slice(1) : [...prev];
        newData.push({
          name: now.toString(),
          value: [
            `${now.getFullYear()}/${now.getMonth() + 1}/${now.getDate()} ${now.getHours()}:${String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0")}`,
            newValue,
          ],
        });
        return newData;
      });
    }, 3000);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [isAuthenticated]);

  // Handle window resize
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleResize = () => {
      chartInstance.current?.resize();
    };
    window.addEventListener("resize", handleResize);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("resize", handleResize);
  }, []);

  if (!isAuthenticated) {
    return (
      <div className="flex h-[300px] items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-text-secondary">
        Log in to view your portfolio chart
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex h-[300px] items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-text-secondary">
        Loading...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg p-2">
      <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between">
        <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-text-primary">Portfolio Value</h3>
        <span className="text-lg font-bold text-primary">
          ${totalValue.toFixed(2)}
        </span>
      </div>
      <div ref={chartRef} style={{ height: "300px", width: "100%" }} />
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="terminal/components/PortfolioPieChart.tsx">
"use client";

import React, { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import * as echarts from "echarts";
import { useBalances } from "@/hooks/useMarketData";
import { useAuth } from "@/hooks/useAuth";

interface PieData {
  value: number;
  name: string;
}

export default function PortfolioPieChart() {
  const chartRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const chartInstance = useRef<echarts.ECharts | null>(null);
  const { isAuthenticated } = useAuth();
  const { data: balances, isLoading } = useBalances();

  // Calculate total value and asset allocation
  const getPieData = (): PieData[] => {
    if (!balances || balances.length === 0) {
      return [{ value: 1, name: "No Assets" }];
    }

    const data: PieData[] = [];
    for (const bal of balances) {
      const available = parseFloat(bal.available);
      if (available <= 0) continue;

      let value = 0;
      if (bal.symbol === "USDT") {
        value = available;
      } else {
        // For other assets, we'd need a price feed – using dummy prices for now
        const dummyPrice =
          bal.symbol === "BTC" ? 60000 :
          bal.symbol === "ETH" ? 3000 :
          bal.symbol === "SOL" ? 150 :
          bal.symbol === "XRP" ? 0.5 :
          100;
        value = available * dummyPrice;
      }

      if (value > 0) {
        data.push({
          name: bal.symbol,
          value: Math.round(value),
        });
      }
    }

    if (data.length === 0) {
      return [{ value: 1, name: "No Assets" }];
    }

    return data;
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!chartRef.current) return;
    if (!chartInstance.current) {
      chartInstance.current = echarts.init(chartRef.current, "light");
    }

    const pieData = getPieData();

    const option: echarts.EChartsOption = {
      tooltip: {
        trigger: "item",
        formatter: (params: any) => {
          return `${params.name}: $${params.value.toFixed(2)} (${params.percent}%)`;
        },
      },
      legend: {
        orient: "vertical",
        right: "5%",
        top: "center",
        textStyle: {
          color: "#848e9c",
          fontSize: 11,
        },
        itemWidth: 12,
        itemHeight: 12,
      },
      series: [
        {
          name: "Portfolio Allocation",
          type: "pie",
          radius: ["45%", "70%"],
          avoidLabelOverlap: true,
          itemStyle: {
            borderRadius: 4,
            borderColor: "#181a20",
            borderWidth: 2,
          },
          label: {
            show: true,
            color: "#848e9c",
            fontSize: 10,
            formatter: "{b}\n${c}",
          },
          labelLine: {
            lineStyle: {
              color: "#2b3139",
            },
          },
          emphasis: {
            itemStyle: {
              shadowBlur: 10,
              shadowOffsetX: 0,
              shadowColor: "",
            },
          },
          data: pieData,
        },
      ],
    };

    chartInstance.current.setOption(option, true);
    chartInstance.current.resize();

    return () => {
      chartInstance.current?.dispose();
      chartInstance.current = null;
    };
  }, [balances]);

  // Handle window resize
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleResize = () => {
      chartInstance.current?.resize();
    };
    window.addEventListener("resize", handleResize);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("resize", handleResize);
  }, []);

  if (!isAuthenticated) {
    return (
      <div className="flex h-[250px] items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-card text-text-secondary">
        Log in to view your portfolio allocation
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex h-[250px] items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-card text-text-secondary">
        Loading...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg p-4">
      <h3 className="mb-2 text-sm font-semibold text-text-primary">Portfolio Allocation</h3>
      <div ref={chartRef} style={{ height: "250px", width: "100%" }} />
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { connectSocket, useConnection } from "@/lib/websocket";
import { useMarketRows } from "./MarketTable";
import { useUIStore } from "@/lib/store";
import { formatPrice, clsx } from "@/lib/utils";

export function StickyBar() {
  const { data } = useMarketRows();
  const selectedMarket = useUIStore((s) => s.selectedMarket);
  const setSelectedMarket = useUIStore((s) => s.setSelectedMarket);
  const status = useConnection((s) => s.status);

  useEffect(() => {
    connectSocket();
  }, []);

  const statusStyles: Record<string, string> = {
    connected: "bg-profit",
    connecting: "bg-primary",
    disconnected: "bg-text-secondary",
    unavailable: "bg-loss",
  };

  return (
    <div className="sticky bottom-0 z-30 flex items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto border-t border-border bg-background px-2 py-1.5">
      {(data ?? []).map((row) => {
        const active = row.symbol === selectedMarket;
        return (
          <button
            key={row.symbol}
            onClick={() => setSelectedMarket(row.symbol)}
            className={clsx(
              "flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-xs transition-colors",
              active ? "bg-card text-text-primary" : "text-text-secondary hover:text-text-primary"
            )}
          >
            <span className="font-medium">{row.symbol.replace("-PERP", "")}</span>
            <span>{formatPrice(row.lastPrice)}</span>
          </button>
        );
      })}
      <div className="ml-auto flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 px-2">
        <span
          className={clsx(
            "h-2 w-2 rounded-full",
            statusStyles[status] ?? "bg-text-secondary"
          )}
        />
        <span className="text-xs capitalize text-text-secondary">{status}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import type { ButtonHTMLAttributes, InputHTMLAttributes, ReactNode } from "react";
import { clsx, formatPercent, isPositive } from "@/lib/utils";

export function Card({
  children,
  className,
}: {
  children: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className={clsx("rounded-lg shadow-[0_2px_8px_rgba(0,0,0,0.3)]", className)}>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

type ButtonVariant = "primary" | "sell" | "ghost" | "outline";

export function Button({
  variant = "primary",
  className,
  children,
  ...props
}: ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> & { variant?: ButtonVariant }) {
  const styles: Record<ButtonVariant, string> = {
    primary: "bg-primary text-black font-semibold hover:bg-primary-hover",
    sell: "bg-loss text-white hover:bg-[#D43B52]",
    ghost: "text-text-primary hover:bg-card",
    outline: "border border-border text-text-primary hover:bg-card",
  };
  return (
    <button
      className={clsx(
        "rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm transition-colors disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50",
        styles[variant],
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

export function Input({ className, ...props }: InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>) {
  return (
    <input
      className={clsx(
        "w-full rounded-md border border-border bg-background px-3 py-2 text-text-primary placeholder:text-text-secondary focus:border-primary focus:outline-none",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

export function PriceChange({
  value,
  className,
}: {
  value: string | number | null | undefined;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const positive = isPositive(value);
  return (
    <span
      className={clsx(positive ? "text-profit" : "text-loss", className)}
    >
      {formatPercent(value)}
    </span>
  );
}

export function StatusPill({ status }: { status: string }) {
  const styles: Record<string, string> = {
    open: "text-profit",
    pending: "text-text-secondary",
    filled: "text-primary",
    canceled: "text-text-secondary",
    rejected: "text-loss",
    partially_filled: "text-profit",
    expired: "text-text-secondary",
  };
  return (
    <span
      className={clsx(
        "rounded-full border border-border px-2 py-0.5 text-xs capitalize",
        styles[status] ?? "text-text-secondary"
      )}
    >
      {status.replace("_", " ")}
    </span>
  );
}

export function EmptyState({ title, hint }: { title: string; hint?: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 py-12 text-center">
      <p className="text-sm font-medium text-text-secondary">{title}</p>
      {hint && <p className="text-xs text-text-secondary/70">{hint}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

export function LoadingRow() {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-10 text-sm text-text-secondary">
      <span className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin rounded-full border-2 border-border border-t-primary" />
      Loading…
    </div>
  );
}

export function SectionHeader({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-text-primary">{children}</h2>
  );
}

<file path="terminal/hooks/useAuth.tsx">
"use client";

import {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useState,
  type ReactNode,
} from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { api, clearToken, getStoredUser, getToken, setToken, storeUser, type AuthUser } from "@/lib/api";

interface AuthContextValue {
  user: AuthUser | null;
  loading: boolean;
  isAuthenticated: boolean;
  login: (token: string, user: AuthUser) => void;
  logout: () => void;
}

const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextValue | null>(null);

export function AuthProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [user, setUser] = useState<AuthUser | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(() => !getToken());
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  useEffect(() => {
    const token = getToken();
    if (!token) return;
    let cancelled = false;
    api
      .me()
      .then((me) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setUser(me);
        storeUser(me);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        clearToken();
        setUser(null);
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  const login = useCallback((token: string, authUser: AuthUser) => {
    setToken(token);
    storeUser(authUser);
    setUser(authUser);
  }, []);

  const logout = useCallback(() => {
    clearToken();
    setUser(null);
    queryClient.clear();
  }, [queryClient]);

  const value = useMemo<AuthContextValue>(
    () => ({ user, loading, isAuthenticated: !!user, login, logout }),
    [user, loading, login, logout]
  );

  return <AuthContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</AuthContext.Provider>;
}

export function useAuth(): AuthContextValue {
  const ctx = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error("useAuth must be used within AuthProvider");
  return ctx;
}

export function useRequireAuth(redirectTo = "/login"): AuthContextValue {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const router = useRouter();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!auth.loading && !auth.isAuthenticated) {
      router.replace(redirectTo);
    }
  }, [auth.loading, auth.isAuthenticated, router, redirectTo]);

  return auth;
}

/**
 * Exchange API Client
 *
 * Typed HTTP client for the Exchange REST API. All monetary values are strings
 * (matching the backend's `numeric(30,8)` format). Authentication is JWT-based
 * with automatic Bearer token injection for protected endpoints.
 *
 * No WebSocket endpoint exists on the backend. All real-time data must be polled.
 */

import { API_BASE_URL, TOKEN_KEY, USER_KEY } from "./constants";

// ─── Error Handling ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** Structured error thrown by every `api.*` method on non-2xx responses. */
export class ApiError extends Error {
  /** HTTP status code. */
  readonly status: number;
  /** Validation issues array from Zod (when `error === "validation_error"`). */
  readonly issues?: unknown;

  constructor(status: number, message: string, issues?: unknown) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "ApiError";
    this.status = status;
    this.issues = issues;
  }
}

// ─── Token / User Persistence ────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** Read the JWT from localStorage. Returns `null` during SSR or when absent. */
export function getToken(): string | null {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;
  return window.localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY);
}

/** Persist the JWT to localStorage. No-op during SSR. */
export function setToken(token: string): void {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  window.localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, token);
}

/** Remove JWT and cached user from localStorage. No-op during SSR. */
export function clearToken(): void {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  window.localStorage.removeItem(TOKEN_KEY);
  window.localStorage.removeItem(USER_KEY);
}

/** Read the cached `AuthUser` from localStorage. Returns `null` during SSR. */
export function getStoredUser(): AuthUser | null {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;
  const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(USER_KEY);
  if (!raw) return null;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw) as AuthUser;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/** Persist an `AuthUser` to localStorage. No-op during SSR. */
export function storeUser(user: AuthUser): void {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  window.localStorage.setItem(USER_KEY, JSON.stringify(user));
}

// ─── Internal Request Engine ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface RequestOptions {
  method?: string;
  body?: unknown;
  auth?: boolean;
  signal?: AbortSignal;
}

/**
 * Core HTTP request helper. All `api.*` methods funnel through here.
 *
 * - Prepends `API_BASE_URL` to the path.
 * - Attaches `Authorization: Bearer <token>` when `auth: true`.
 * - Parses error responses for `{ error, issues }` shape from the backend.
 * - Throws `ApiError` with status code, message, and optional validation issues.
 */
async function request<T>(path: string, options: RequestOptions = {}): Promise<T> {
  const { method = "GET", body, auth = false, signal } = options;
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {};
  if (body !== undefined) headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json";
  if (auth) {
    const token = getToken();
    if (token) headers["Authorization"] = `Bearer ${token}`;
  }
  const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}${path}`, {
    method,
    headers,
    body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body),
    signal,
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    let message = `Request failed (${res.status})`;
    let issues: unknown;
    try {
      const data = (await res.json()) as { error?: string; issues?: unknown };
      if (data.error) message = data.error;
      issues = data.issues;
    } catch {
      // Response body was not JSON — fall through with default message.
    }
    throw new ApiError(res.status, message, issues);
  }
  return (await res.json()) as T;
}

/** Build a URLSearchParams string from an optional record, omitting undefined values. */
function qs(params: Record<string, string | number | undefined>): string {
  const sp = new URLSearchParams();
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(params)) {
    if (v !== undefined && v !== "") sp.set(k, String(v));
  }
  const s = sp.toString();
  return s ? `?${s}` : "";
}

// ─── Public API ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Typed API client for the Exchange REST API.
 *
 * Every method maps 1:1 to a backend endpoint. Return types are inferred
 * from the backend's response shapes. Methods that require authentication
 * pass `{ auth: true }` which auto-attaches the Bearer token from localStorage.
 */
export const api = {
  // ── Health ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Check API health. No auth required.
   * `GET /health`
   */
  health: () => request<HealthResponse>("/health"),

  // ── Auth ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Register a new user account.
   * `POST /auth/register` — Public
   */
  register: (email: string, password: string, name: string) =>
    request<AuthResponse>("/auth/register", {
      method: "POST",
      body: { email, password, name },
    }),

  /**
   * Log in with email and password. Returns JWT and user profile.
   * `POST /auth/login` — Public
   */
  login: (email: string, password: string) =>
    request<AuthResponse>("/auth/login", { method: "POST", body: { email, password } }),

  /**
   * Fetch the current user's profile using the stored JWT.
   * `GET /auth/me` — Auth required
   */
  me: () => request<AuthUser>("/auth/me", { auth: true }),

  /**
   * Log out the current user. Stateless JWT — client must clear token.
   * `POST /auth/logout` — Auth required
   */
  logout: () => request<{ ok: boolean }>("/auth/logout", { method: "POST", auth: true }),

  // ── Markets ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * List all active markets. Returns resolved asset symbols (e.g. `"BTC"`).
   * `GET /markets` — Public
   */
  listMarkets: () => request<{ markets: Market[] }>("/markets"),

  /**
   * Get detailed market info by symbol. Returns raw asset UUIDs
   * (`baseAssetId` / `quoteAssetId`) instead of resolved symbols.
   * `GET /markets/:symbol` — Public
   */
  getMarket: (symbol: string) =>
    request<MarketDetail>(`/markets/${encodeURIComponent(symbol)}`),

  /**
   * Get the current orderbook depth for a symbol.
   * Each level is a `[price, quantity]` string tuple.
   * `GET /markets/:symbol/orderbook?depth=N` — Public
   */
  getOrderbook: (symbol: string, depth = 20) =>
    request<Orderbook>(
      `/markets/${encodeURIComponent(symbol)}/orderbook${qs({ depth })}`
    ),

  /**
   * Get recent public trades for a symbol.
   * `GET /markets/:symbol/trades?limit=N` — Public
   */
  getTrades: (symbol: string, limit = 50) =>
    request<{ symbol: string; trades: Fill[] }>(
      `/markets/${encodeURIComponent(symbol)}/trades${qs({ limit })}`
    ),

  /**
   * Get 24h ticker data (last price, volume, trade count) for a symbol.
   * `lastPrice` is `null` when no trades exist.
   * `GET /markets/:symbol/ticker` — Public
   */
  getTicker: (symbol: string) =>
    request<Ticker>(`/markets/${encodeURIComponent(symbol)}/ticker`),

  // ── Balances ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * List all balances for the authenticated user.
   * `GET /balances` — Auth required
   */
  getBalances: () => request<{ balances: Balance[] }>("/balances", { auth: true }),

  /**
   * Deposit an asset (simulated for testing).
   * `POST /balances/deposit` — Auth required
   */
  deposit: (asset: string, amount: string) =>
    request<BalanceChange>("/balances/deposit", {
      method: "POST",
      body: { asset, amount },
      auth: true,
    }),

  /**
   * Withdraw an asset (deducts from available balance).
   * `POST /balances/withdraw` — Auth required
   */
  withdraw: (asset: string, amount: string) =>
    request<BalanceChange>("/balances/withdraw", {
      method: "POST",
      body: { asset, amount },
      auth: true,
    }),

  // ── Orders ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Place a new order. For `limit` orders, `price` is required.
   * Returns the created order. If `clientOrderId` is reused, returns the
   * existing order with `idempotent: true`.
   *
   * Recommended payload shape: `PlaceOrderPayload`. The parameter accepts
   * `Record<string, unknown>` for backward compatibility with existing callers.
   *
   * `POST /orders` — Auth required
   */
  placeOrder: (payload: PlaceOrderPayload | Record<string, unknown>) =>
    request<{ order: Order; idempotent: boolean }>("/orders", {
      method: "POST",
      body: payload,
      auth: true,
    }),

  /**
   * List orders with optional filters. Results are ordered by `created_at DESC`.
   * `GET /orders?status=&market=&limit=` — Auth required
   */
  listOrders: (params: { status?: string; market?: string; limit?: number } = {}) => {
    const q = qs({
      status: params.status,
      market: params.market,
      limit: params.limit,
    });
    return request<{ orders: Order[] }>(`/orders${q}`, { auth: true });
  },

  /**
   * Get a single order by ID.
   * `GET /orders/:id` — Auth required
   */
  getOrder: (id: string) =>
    request<Order>(`/orders/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { auth: true }),

  /**
   * Cancel a single open order by ID.
   * `DELETE /orders/:id` — Auth required
   */
  cancelOrder: (id: string) =>
    request<{ orderId: string; status: "canceled" }>(
      `/orders/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`,
      { method: "DELETE", auth: true }
    ),

  /**
   * Cancel all open orders, optionally filtered by market symbol.
   * `DELETE /orders?market=` — Auth required
   */
  cancelAllOrders: (market?: string) => {
    const q = qs({ market });
    return request<{ canceled: number }>(`/orders${q}`, {
      method: "DELETE",
      auth: true,
    });
  },

  // ── Positions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * List positions filtered by status (default `"open"`).
   * `GET /positions?status=` — Auth required
   */
  listPositions: (status = "open") =>
    request<{ positions: Position[] }>(`/positions${qs({ status })}`, { auth: true }),

  /**
   * Get a single position by ID.
   * `GET /positions/:id` — Auth required
   */
  getPosition: (id: string) =>
    request<Position>(`/positions/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { auth: true }),

  /**
   * Close an open position by creating a reduce-only market order in the
   * opposite direction.
   * `POST /positions/:id/close` — Auth required
   */
  closePosition: (id: string) =>
    request<{ order: Order }>(
      `/positions/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/close`,
      { method: "POST", auth: true }
    ),

  // ── Fills ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * List the user's trade fills (as maker or taker).
   * Ordered by `created_at DESC`.
   * `GET /fills?limit=` — Auth required
   */
  listFills: (limit = 50) =>
    request<{ fills: Fill[] }>(`/fills${qs({ limit })}`, { auth: true }),

  // ── Funding ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * List the user's funding payment history.
   * `GET /funding/payments?limit=` — Auth required
   */
  listFundingPayments: (limit = 100) =>
    request<{ payments: FundingPayment[] }>(
      `/funding/payments${qs({ limit })}`,
      { auth: true }
    ),
};

<file path="terminal/lib/chartData.ts">
import type { Candle } from "@/components/CandlestickChart";
import type { Fill } from "@/lib/api";

export const CANDLE_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 60;

export function buildCandles(trades: Fill[], interval = CANDLE_INTERVAL_SECONDS): Candle[] {
  const buckets = new Map<number, Candle>();

  for (const trade of trades) {
    const ts = new Date(trade.createdAt).getTime() / 1000;
    if (Number.isNaN(ts)) continue;
    const bucket = Math.floor(ts / interval) * interval;
    const price = Number(trade.price);
    const existing = buckets.get(bucket);
    if (!existing) {
      buckets.set(bucket, {
        time: bucket,
        open: price,
        high: price,
        low: price,
        close: price,
      });
      continue;
    }
    existing.high = Math.max(existing.high, price);
    existing.low = Math.min(existing.low, price);
    existing.close = price;
  }

  return Array.from(buckets.values())
    .sort((a, b) => a.time - b.time)
    .map((c) => ({ ...c, high: c.high, low: c.low }));
}

let client: QueryClient | undefined;

export function getQueryClient(): QueryClient {
  if (!client) {
    client = new QueryClient({
      defaultOptions: {
        queries: {
          staleTime: 5_000,
          gcTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
          retry: 1,
          refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
        },
      },
    });
  }

import { create } from "zustand";

export type OrderSide = "buy" | "sell";
export type OrderType = "limit" | "market";

interface UIState {
  selectedMarket: string;
  orderSide: OrderSide;
  orderType: OrderType;
  price: string;
  amount: string;
  leverage: string;
  mobileNavOpen: boolean;
  favorites: string[];
  setSelectedMarket: (market: string) => void;
  setOrderSide: (side: OrderSide) => void;
  setOrderType: (type: OrderType) => void;
  setPrice: (price: string) => void;
  setAmount: (amount: string) => void;
  setLeverage: (leverage: string) => void;
  setMobileNavOpen: (open: boolean) => void;
  toggleFavorite: (symbol: string) => void;
  resetOrderForm: () => void;
}

const FAVORITES_KEY = "exchange_favorites";

function loadFavorites(): string[] {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return [];
  try {
    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(FAVORITES_KEY);
    return raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as string[]) : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function saveFavorites(favorites: string[]): void {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  window.localStorage.setItem(FAVORITES_KEY, JSON.stringify(favorites));
}

export const useUIStore = create<UIState>((set) => ({
  selectedMarket: "BTC-USDT-PERP",
  orderSide: "buy",
  orderType: "limit",
  price: "",
  amount: "",
  leverage: "10",
  mobileNavOpen: false,
  favorites: loadFavorites(),
  setSelectedMarket: (market) => set({ selectedMarket: market }),
  setOrderSide: (side) => set({ orderSide: side }),
  setOrderType: (type) => set({ orderType: type }),
  setPrice: (price) => set({ price }),
  setAmount: (amount) => set({ amount }),
  setLeverage: (leverage) => set({ leverage }),
  setMobileNavOpen: (open) => set({ mobileNavOpen: open }),
  toggleFavorite: (symbol) =>
    set((state) => {
      const has = state.favorites.includes(symbol);
      const favorites = has
        ? state.favorites.filter((s) => s !== symbol)
        : [...state.favorites, symbol];
      saveFavorites(favorites);
      return { favorites };
    }),
  resetOrderForm: () => set({ price: "", amount: "" }),
}));

<file path="terminal/lib/utils.ts">
export function formatPrice(value: string | number | null | undefined, decimals = 2): string {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "") return "—";
  const num = Number(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(num)) return "—";
  return num.toLocaleString("en-US", {
    minimumFractionDigits: decimals,
    maximumFractionDigits: decimals,
  });
}

export function formatNumber(value: string | number | null | undefined, decimals = 4): string {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "") return "—";
  const num = Number(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(num)) return "—";
  return num.toLocaleString("en-US", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 0,
    maximumFractionDigits: decimals,
  });
}

export function formatUsd(value: string | number | null | undefined): string {
  const num = Number(value ?? 0);
  return num.toLocaleString("en-US", {
    style: "currency",
    currency: "USD",
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  });
}

export function formatPercent(value: string | number | null | undefined): string {
  const num = Number(value ?? 0);
  const sign = num > 0 ? "+" : "";
  return `${sign}${num.toFixed(2)}%`;
}

export function formatTime(value: string | Date | null | undefined): string {
  if (!value) return "—";
  const d = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return "—";
  return d.toLocaleString("en-US", {
    month: "short",
    day: "numeric",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
    second: "2-digit",
  });
}

export function clsx(...classes: Array<string | false | null | undefined>): string {
  return classes.filter(Boolean).join(" ");
}

export function isPositive(value: string | number | null | undefined): boolean {
  return Number(value ?? 0) >= 0;
}

export function marketBase(symbol: string): string {
  const base = symbol.split("-")[0];
  return base ?? symbol;
}

export function marketQuote(symbol: string): string {
  return symbol.split("-")[1] ?? "USDT";
}

export function truncateMiddle(id: string, len = 8): string {
  if (!id || id.length <= len * 2) return id;
  return `${id.slice(0, len)}…${id.slice(-len)}`;
}

<file path="terminal/lib/websocket.ts">
import { create } from "zustand";
import { WS_URL } from "./constants";

export type ConnectionStatus = "connecting" | "connected" | "disconnected" | "unavailable";

interface ConnectionState {
  status: ConnectionStatus;
  lastMessageAt: number | null;
  setStatus: (status: ConnectionStatus) => void;
}

export const useConnection = create<ConnectionState>((set) => ({
  status: "disconnected",
  lastMessageAt: null,
  setStatus: (status) =>
    set((state) => ({
      status,
      lastMessageAt: status === "connected" ? Date.now() : state.lastMessageAt,
    })),
}));

let socket: WebSocket | null = null;
let reconnectTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
let attempts = 0;

const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3;

export function connectSocket(): void {
  const { status, setStatus } = useConnection.getState();
  if (socket || status === "unavailable") return;

  setStatus("connecting");
  let ws: WebSocket;
  try {
    ws = new WebSocket(WS_URL);
  } catch {
    setStatus("unavailable");
    return;
  }
  socket = ws;

  ws.onopen = () => {
    attempts = 0;
    setStatus("connected");
  };

  ws.onmessage = () => {
    setStatus("connected");
  };

  ws.onerror = () => {
    // Backend has no WebSocket endpoint; degrade to polling.
    setStatus("unavailable");
  };

  ws.onclose = () => {
    socket = null;
    setStatus("disconnected");
    if (attempts < MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
      attempts += 1;
      reconnectTimer = setTimeout(connectSocket, 2000 * attempts);
    } else {
      setStatus("unavailable");
    }
  };
}

export function disconnectSocket(): void {
  if (reconnectTimer) clearTimeout(reconnectTimer);
  reconnectTimer = null;
  if (socket) {
    socket.onclose = null;
    socket.close();
    socket = null;
  }
  useConnection.getState().setStatus("disconnected");
}
</file>

# CLAUDE.md — Frontend Implementation for Exchange Terminal

## 1. Project Overview

You are to implement the frontend for a **Perpetual Futures Crypto Exchange** inside the `terminal` directory of the monorepo `Exchange`. The backend is already built and running (REST API, matching engine, Redis, Kafka). Your job is to create a production‑ready, scalable, fast, responsive Next.js application that matches the provided UI designs and interacts with the backend API.

- **Backend API Base URL**: `http://localhost:3000/api/v1` (or `http://localhost:3001` if backend runs on a different port – inspect the backend config to confirm). Use environment variables (`NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL`) to configure.
- **Frontend location**: `terminal/` (Next.js app). You have **read access to the entire repository** but **write access only within `terminal/`**.
- **Existing files**: There is already a basic Next.js structure with a `components` folder and some pages. Do **not** delete or rename any existing files. Extend and modify them as needed. If a page/component is missing, create it in the appropriate location.
- **Package manager**: Use the same package manager as the monorepo (likely `npm` or `pnpm`). Check root `package.json` for `"packageManager"`.

## 2. Tech Stack & Libraries

- **Next.js** (App Router) — use `app/` directory.
- **TypeScript** — strict mode.
- **Tailwind CSS** — extend the configuration with the custom design tokens below.
- **TanStack Query** (`@tanstack/react-query`) — for server state, caching, and data fetching.
- **Zustand** (`zustand`) — for client state (UI, order form, WebSocket data).
- **lightweight-charts** — for candlestick chart on Trade page.
- **react-hook-form** — for form handling (optional but recommended).
- **lucide-react** — for icons.
- **date-fns** — for date formatting (optional).

> If any of these libraries are not installed, install them within `terminal/`.

## 3. Design System

### Colors

| Token                | Hex       | Usage                                  |
|----------------------|-----------|----------------------------------------|
| `background`         | `#181A20` | Main body background                   |
| `card`               | `#1E2329` | Cards, panels, tables                  |
| `border`             | `#2B3139` | Borders, dividers                      |
| `primary`            | `#F0B90B` | Yellow accent (buttons, active states) |
| `text-primary`       | `#EAECEF` | Main text                              |
| `text-secondary`     | `#848E9C` | Subtext, labels, placeholders          |
| `profit`             | `#0ECB81` | Positive values                        |
| `loss`               | `#F6465D` | Negative values                        |

### Typography

- Font family: `Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif`.
- Load via `next/font/google` in root layout: `Inter({ subsets: ['latin'] })`.
- Font sizes: base `14px`; use Tailwind classes like `text-sm`, `text-base`, `text-lg`, `text-xl`, `text-2xl`.

### Spacing & Borders

- Container max width: `1280px` (or `1440px` for full‑width tables). Center with `mx-auto px-4 md:px-6`.
- Border radius: `rounded-lg` for cards, `rounded-md` for inputs/buttons, `rounded-full` for pills.
- Shadows: subtle dark shadow for cards: `shadow-[0_2px_8px_rgba(0,0,0,0.3)]`.

### Buttons

- **Primary (Buy)**: `bg-primary text-black font-semibold hover:bg-[#D99E0A]`.
- **Sell** (or destructive): `bg-loss text-white hover:bg-[#D43B52]`.
- **Ghost/Outline**: `border border-border text-text-primary hover:bg-card`.
- All buttons: rounded, py-2 px-4.

### Inputs

- `bg-background border border-border rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-text-primary placeholder-text-secondary focus:border-primary focus:outline-none`.

## 4. Global Layout & Navigation

### Root Layout (`app/layout.tsx`)

- Include global CSS, Tailwind directives, and the `Inter` font.
- Render a `<Providers>` component that sets up TanStack Query (`QueryClientProvider`) and any other global providers (Zustand store, auth context).
- Include a `<Toaster>` for notifications (optional).
- Ensure the whole app uses `min-h-screen bg-background text-text-primary`.

### Navbar Component (`components/Navbar.tsx`)

- Fixed at top (`sticky top-0 z-50`), background `bg-background`, border-bottom `border-b border-border`.
- Contains:
  - Left: Logo (exchange name, e.g., "BINANCE" but replace with your own brand – use `"EXCHANGE"`). Style: bold white, with yellow dot or accent.
  - Center (desktop): Nav links: `Buy Crypto`, `Markets`, `Trade`, `Futures`, `Earn`, `Square`, `More`. Use `Link` from Next.js. Active state: yellow text / underline. Hover: text-text-primary.
  - Right:
    - If user is **not authenticated**: Show `Login` and `Register` buttons (link to `/login` and `/register`).
    - If user is **authenticated**:
      - Show balance indicator (e.g., `$0.00`) from user's portfolio.
      - Show `Deposit` button (ghost style).
      - Show user avatar / profile icon (link to `/profile`).
      - Show `Logout` button.
- On mobile: Use a hamburger menu (or simple icon) to toggle a drawer containing the nav links. The drawer should slide in from the right or left.

### Footer Component (`components/Footer.tsx`)

- Sticky at bottom? Not necessary; place at bottom of each page.
- Design as described in the homepage prompt (multi‑column sitemap). Include company links, support, legal, etc.
- Bottom bar with language selector, currency, theme switcher, and copyright.
- Replace all "Binance" texts with your exchange name.

## 5. Pages Implementation

All pages are under `app/` directory with `page.tsx`. Use Next.js App Router features: Server Components for static parts, Client Components for interactive parts.

### 5.1 Home Page (`app/page.tsx`)

Follow the provided Homepage design:

- Protect routes that require auth (Trade, Profile) by checking token in client‑side layout or using middleware.

## 6. Data Fetching & State Management

### TanStack Query Setup

- Create `lib/queryClient.ts` and wrap the app in `QueryClientProvider` in `app/providers.tsx`.
- Set default `staleTime` to 5 seconds for public data, 10 seconds for user data.

### REST API Calls

- Create API utility functions in `lib/api.ts` to call the backend. Use `fetch` with appropriate headers (Authorization Bearer token).
- Example endpoints:
  - `GET /markets`
  - `GET /markets/:symbol/orderbook`
  - `GET /markets/:symbol/trades`
  - `GET /balances` (auth)
  - `POST /orders` (auth)
  - `GET /orders` (auth)
  - `GET /positions` (auth)
- Use TanStack Query hooks (`useQuery`, `useMutation`) for these calls.
- For mutations (place order, cancel order), invalidate relevant queries on success.

### Real‑time Updates (WebSocket)

- Create a WebSocket client (in `lib/websocket.ts`) that connects to the backend's WebSocket endpoint (if available). The backend likely exposes a WebSocket server at `ws://localhost:3000/ws` or similar; if not, fallback to polling with `refetchInterval`.
- On messages, update TanStack Query cache using `queryClient.setQueryData` for orderbook, trades, balances, positions.
- Use Zustand to manage connection status and last message.
- If WebSocket is not available, use polling (e.g., `refetchInterval: 1000` for orderbook, trades).

### Client State (Zustand)

- Create a store for UI state: selected market, buy/sell toggle, order form inputs, mobile menu open/close, etc.
- Keep it simple; don't overcomplicate.

## 7. Caching Strategy

- Use TanStack Query caching for all REST data. Set `staleTime` and `gcTime` appropriately.
- For public market data (markets list, ticker), set `staleTime: 5000`.
- For user data (balances, orders, positions), set `staleTime: 10000` but invalidate after mutations.
- For real‑time data from WebSocket, update the cache immediately and do not refetch unless necessary.

## 8. Responsiveness & Performance

- **No hardcoded widths/heights**. Use Tailwind responsive classes (`sm:`, `md:`, `lg:`, `xl:`).
- Use `flex`, `grid`, and `gap` for layout. For the Trade page, use CSS Grid with `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-[280px_1fr_340px]` so it stacks on mobile.
- For tables, use `overflow-x-auto` to scroll horizontally on small screens.
- For large lists (orderbook, trades), use virtualization with `@tanstack/react-virtual` if performance becomes an issue (optional).
- Avoid unnecessary re‑renders: use `React.memo` for orderbook rows, trade rows.
- Lazy load heavy components (chart, large tables) using `next/dynamic` with `ssr: false` if needed.

## 9. Environment Variables

- Create `.env.local` in `terminal/` with:
  ```
  NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000/api/v1
  NEXT_PUBLIC_WS_URL=ws://localhost:3000/ws
  ```
- Use these variables in API calls.

## 10. Acceptance Criteria

- All pages render correctly with the given design system.
- Navbar and Footer are present on every page.
- Home, BuyCrypto, Markets, Trade, Profile are fully implemented with the described UI.
- Trade page displays orderbook, chart, and order form; placing a buy/sell order calls the backend and updates UI accordingly.
- Authentication works (login/register), and protected routes redirect to login if not authenticated.
- All API calls use TanStack Query and are cached.
- WebSocket integration for real‑time updates is attempted; if not possible, polling fallback is in place.
- The app is responsive and works on mobile, tablet, and desktop.
- No broken TypeScript types, no `any` unless absolutely necessary.
- Code is clean, well‑organised, and follows React best practices.

<file path="bot/botWorker.ts">
// bot/botWorker.ts
import { CONFIG } from './config.js';
import { apiRequest, sleep, randomBetween, randomInt } from './utils.js';

export interface BotState {
  email: string;
  token: string;
  userId: string;
  balances: Record<string, number>; // asset -> available
  activeOrders: Set<string>; // order IDs to track
}

export class BotWorker {
  private state: BotState | null = null;
  private running = true;
  private marketIndex = 0;

  constructor(private readonly botId: number) {}

  async initialize() {
    // Register or login existing
    const email = `bot${this.botId}@sim.local`;
    try {
      // Try login first
      const login = await apiRequest(null, 'POST', '/auth/login', {
        email,
        password: CONFIG.BOT_PASSWORD,
      });
      this.state = {
        email,
        token: login.token,
        userId: login.user.id,
        balances: {},
        activeOrders: new Set(),
      };
      console.log(`Bot ${this.botId} logged in as ${email}`);
    } catch {
      // Register new
      const reg = await apiRequest(null, 'POST', '/auth/register', {
        email,
        password: CONFIG.BOT_PASSWORD,
        name: `Bot ${this.botId}`,
      });
      this.state = {
        email,
        token: reg.token,
        userId: reg.user.id,
        balances: {},
        activeOrders: new Set(),
      };
      console.log(`Bot ${this.botId} registered as ${email}`);
      // Initial deposits
      for (const [asset, amount] of Object.entries(CONFIG.INITIAL_DEPOSITS)) {
        try {
          await apiRequest(this.state.token, 'POST', '/balances/deposit', {
            asset,
            amount: String(amount),
          });
        } catch (e) {
          // ignore if already deposited
        }
      }
    }
  }

  private async getLastPrice(market: string): Promise<number> {
    try {
      const ticker = await apiRequest(this.state!.token, 'GET', `/markets/${market}/ticker`);
      return parseFloat(ticker.lastPrice) || 50000;
    } catch {
      return 50000; // fallback
    }
  }

  private async placeOrder(
    market: string,
    side: 'buy' | 'sell',
    orderType: 'limit' | 'market',
    price?: number,
    quantity?: number
  ) {
    const body: any = {
      market,
      side,
      orderType,
      quantity: String(quantity || 0.001),
      leverage: '1',
      timeInForce: 'GTC',
    };
    if (orderType === 'limit' && price) body.price = String(price);
    try {
      const result = await apiRequest(this.state!.token, 'POST', '/orders', body);
      if (result.order) this.state!.activeOrders.add(result.order.id);
      return result.order;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  private async cancelOrder(orderId: string) {
    try {
      await apiRequest(this.state!.token, 'DELETE', `/orders/${orderId}`);
      this.state!.activeOrders.delete(orderId);
    } catch {}
  }

  private async cancelAllForMarket(market: string) {
    try {
      await apiRequest(this.state!.token, 'DELETE', `/orders?market=${market}`);
      // Remove all from activeOrders that belong to this market (we don't track per market)
      // For simplicity, we'll clear the set and rely on re‑placement.
      this.state!.activeOrders.clear();
    } catch {}
  }

  // ─── Strategy: Market Maker ──────────────────────────────
  private async runMaker(market: string) {
    const price = await this.getLastPrice(market);
    const spread = price * 0.001; // 0.1% spread
    const bidPrice = price - spread;
    const askPrice = price + spread;
    const qty = 0.001 * (1 + randomBetween(0, 2)); // 0.001–0.003

    // Cancel old orders for this market to avoid piling up
    await this.cancelAllForMarket(market);

    // Place new orders
    await this.placeOrder(market, 'buy', 'limit', bidPrice, qty);
    await this.placeOrder(market, 'sell', 'limit', askPrice, qty);
  }

  // ─── Strategy: Market Taker ──────────────────────────────
  private async runTaker(market: string) {
    const side = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 'buy' : 'sell';
    const qty = 0.001 * (1 + randomBetween(0, 1.5));
    const price = await this.getLastPrice(market);
    // For market buy, price is needed for margin calculation
    await this.placeOrder(market, side, 'market', price, qty);
  }

  // ─── Strategy: Whale (large limit orders) ──────────────
  private async runWhale(market: string) {
    const price = await this.getLastPrice(market);
    // Place a large order far from the market to simulate a pending large trade
    const offset = price * 0.02; // 2% away
    const side = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 'buy' : 'sell';
    const priceOffset = side === 'buy' ? price - offset : price + offset;
    const qty = 0.01 * (1 + randomBetween(0, 4)); // 0.01–0.05 BTC
    await this.placeOrder(market, side, 'limit', priceOffset, qty);
  }

  // ─── Main Loop ────────────────────────────────────────────
  async start() {
    if (!this.state) await this.initialize();
    console.log(`Bot ${this.botId} starting loops...`);

    while (this.running) {
      const market = CONFIG.MARKETS[this.marketIndex % CONFIG.MARKETS.length];
      this.marketIndex++;

      // Randomly pick a strategy
      const strategy = randomInt(1, 3);
      try {
        if (strategy === 1) {
          await this.runMaker(market);
        } else if (strategy === 2) {
          await this.runTaker(market);
        } else {
          await this.runWhale(market);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        // log but continue
        console.error(`Bot ${this.botId} error on ${market}:`, err);
      }

      await sleep(CONFIG.LOOP_INTERVAL);
    }
  }

  stop() {
    this.running = false;
  }
}
