<file path="terminal/app/register/page.tsx">
"use client";

import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { api } from "@/lib/api";
import { useAuth } from "@/hooks/useAuth";
import { Card, Button, Input } from "@/components/ui";

export default function RegisterPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { login } = useAuth();
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    if (password !== confirm) {
      setError("Passwords do not match");
      return;
    }
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await api.register(email, password, name);
      login(res.token, res.user);
      router.replace("/trade");
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Registration failed");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-md flex-col items-center px-4 py-16">
      <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-text-primary">Create your account</h1>
      <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-text-secondary">
        Register in seconds and start trading.
      </p>

      <Card className="mt-8 w-full p-6">
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <div>
            <label className="mb-1 block text-sm text-text-secondary">Name</label>
            <Input
              required
              value={name}
              onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Jane Doe"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="mb-1 block text-sm text-text-secondary">Email</label>
            <Input
              type="email"
              required
              autoComplete="email"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="you@example.com"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="mb-1 block text-sm text-text-secondary">Password</label>
            <Input
              type="password"
              required
              minLength={8}
              autoComplete="new-password"
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Minimum 8 characters"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="mb-1 block text-sm text-text-secondary">Confirm password</label>
            <Input
              type="password"
              required
              autoComplete="new-password"
              value={confirm}
              onChange={(e) => setConfirm(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="••••••••"
            />
          </div>
          {error && (
            <p className="rounded-md bg-loss/10 p-2 text-sm text-loss">{error}</p>
          )}
          <Button type="submit" disabled={loading} className="w-full">
            {loading ? "Creating account…" : "Register"}
          </Button>
        </form>
      </Card>

      <p className="mt-4 text-sm text-text-secondary">
        Already have an account?{" "}
        <Link href="/login" className="font-medium text-primary hover:text-primary-hover">
          Log in
        </Link>
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

function MarketPicker({
  selectedMarket,
  onSelect,
}: {
  selectedMarket: string;
  onSelect: (symbol: string) => void;
}) {
  const { data: markets } = useMarkets();
  return (
    <div className="no-scrollbar flex items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto border-b border-border px-2 py-1.5">
      {(markets ?? []).map((m) => {
        const base = m.symbol.split("-")[0];
        const active = m.symbol === selectedMarket;
        return (
          <button
            key={m.symbol}
            onClick={() => onSelect(m.symbol)}
            className={clsx(
              "shrink-0 rounded-md px-3 py-1 text-sm transition-colors",
              active ? "bg-primary font-semibold text-black" : "text-text-secondary hover:text-text-primary"
            )}
          >
            {base}/USDT
          </button>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}







function NavTicker({ ticker }: { ticker: Ticker | undefined }) {
  if (!ticker || ticker.lastPrice === null) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full mx-auto text-[#eaeef4] flex gap-6">
        <div className="mb-2 ml-2">
          <div className="text-[9px] text-[#8d93a0]">Loading ticker…</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const pair = ticker.symbol.split("-").join("/");
  const price = formatPrice(Number(ticker.lastPrice));
  const volumeUsdt = formatNumber(Number(ticker.volume24h));

  return (
    <div className="w-full mx-auto text-[#eaeef4] flex gap-6">
      
      {/* ─── Header: pair & price ─── */}
      <div className="mb-2 ml-2">
        <div className="text-[9px] text-[#8d93a0]">{pair}</div>
        <div className="text-[15px] font-bold tracking-tight">{price}</div>
      </div>

      {/* ─── Grid: 2 columns ─── */}
      <div className="flex gap-4 border-t border-[#1e232c] pt-2">
        
        {/* 24h Change */}
        <div>
          <div className="text-[9px] text-[#5e6573] uppercase tracking-wider">24h Chg</div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[9px] font-semibold">
            <span>
              —
            </span>
            <span className="text-[9px] text-[#8d93a0]">—</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 24h High */}
        <div>
          <div className="text-[9px] text-[#5e6573] uppercase tracking-wider">24h High</div>
          <div className="text-[9px]">—</div>
        </div>

        {/* 24h Low */}
        <div>
          <div className="text-[9px] text-[#5e6573] uppercase tracking-wider">24h Low</div>
          <div className="text-[9px] font-semibold">—</div>
        </div>

        {/* 24h Vol (BTC) */}
        <div>
          <div className="text-[9px] text-[#5e6573] uppercase tracking-wider">24h Vol (BTC)</div>
          <div className="text-[9px] font-semibold">—</div>

        {/* 24h Vol (USDT) – spans full width */}

          <div className="text-xs text-[#5e6573] uppercase tracking-wider">24h Vol (USDT)</div>

"use client";

import { CandlestickChart } from "lucide-react";
import React, { useEffect, useRef, memo } from "react";

function Chart() {
  const container = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const currentContainer = container.current;
    if (!currentContainer) return;

    // Clear any existing children (important for React StrictMode and hot reloads)
    currentContainer.innerHTML = "";

    const script = document.createElement("script");
    script.src =
      "https://s3.tradingview.com/external-embedding/embed-widget-advanced-chart.js";
    script.type = "text/javascript";
    script.async = true;
    script.innerHTML = JSON.stringify({
      allow_symbol_change: true,
      calendar: false,
      details: false,
      hide_side_toolbar: true,
      hide_top_toolbar: false,
      hide_legend: false,
      hide_volume: false,
      hotlist: false,
      interval: "1",
      locale: "en",
      save_image: true,
      style: "1",
      symbol: "BINANCE:BTCUSDT",
      theme: "dark",
      timezone: "Etc/UTC",
      backgroundColor: "#181a20",
      gridColor: "rgba(74, 74, 74, 0.2)",
      watchlist: [],
      withdateranges: false,
      compareSymbols: [],
      support_host: "https://www.tradingview.com",
      studies: [],
      autosize: true,
    });

    currentContainer.appendChild(script);

    // Cleanup function to remove the script and any extra elements
    return () => {
      if (currentContainer) {
        currentContainer.innerHTML = "";
      }
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <div
      className="tradingview-widget-container"
      ref={container}
      style={{ height: "100%", width: "100%", borderRadius: "50px"}}
    >
      <div
        className="tradingview-widget-container__widget"
        style={{ height: "calc(100% - 32px)", width: "100%" }}
      />
      <div className="tradingview-widget-copyright">
        <a
          href="https://www.tradingview.com/symbols/BTCUSDT/?exchange=BINANCE"
          rel="noopener nofollow"
          target="_blank"
        >
          <span className="blue-text">BTCUSDT price</span>
        </a>
        <span className="trademark"> by TradingView</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default memo(Chart);

<file path="terminal/components/MarketTable.tsx">
"use client";

import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Star } from "lucide-react";
import { api } from "@/lib/api";
import { useUIStore } from "@/lib/store";
import { formatPrice, formatUsd, marketBase, clsx } from "@/lib/utils";
import { LoadingRow, EmptyState } from "./ui";

interface Row {
  symbol: string;
  base: string;
  lastPrice: string | null;
  volume24h: string;
  tradeCount: number;
}

export function useMarketRows() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["market-rows"],
    queryFn: async (): Promise<Row[]> => {
      const res = await api.listMarkets();
      const tickers = await Promise.all(
        res.markets.map((m) => api.getTicker(m.symbol).catch(() => null))
      );
      return res.markets.map((m, i) => {
        const t = tickers[i];
        return {
          symbol: m.symbol,
          base: marketBase(m.symbol),
          lastPrice: t?.lastPrice ?? null,
          volume24h: t?.volume24h ?? "0",
          tradeCount: t?.tradeCount ?? 0,
        };
      });
    },
    staleTime: 5_000,
  });
}

export function MarketTable({ limit, compact }: { limit?: number; compact?: boolean }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { data, isLoading } = useMarketRows();
  const favorites = useUIStore((s) => s.favorites);
  const toggleFavorite = useUIStore((s) => s.toggleFavorite);
  const setSelectedMarket = useUIStore((s) => s.setSelectedMarket);

  const rows = (data ?? []).slice(0, limit);

  const goToTrade = (symbol: string) => {
    setSelectedMarket(symbol);
    router.push("/trade");
  };

  if (isLoading) return <LoadingRow />;
  if (!rows.length) return <EmptyState title="No markets available" />;

  return (
    <div className="overflow-x-auto">
      <table className="w-full text-sm">
        <thead>
          <tr className="border-b border-border text-left text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-text-secondary">
            <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Pair</th>
            <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Price</th>
            <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">24h Volume</th>
            {!compact && <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">24h Trades</th>}
            <th className="px-4 py-3" />
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {rows.map((row) => {
            const fav = favorites.includes(row.symbol);
            return (
              <tr
                key={row.symbol}
                onClick={() => goToTrade(row.symbol)}
                className="cursor-pointer border-b border-border transition-colors hover:bg-card-hover"
              >
                <td className="px-4 py-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <button
                      aria-label="Favorite"
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        toggleFavorite(row.symbol);
                      }}
                      className={clsx(
                        "transition-colors",
                        fav ? "text-primary" : "text-text-secondary hover:text-text-primary"
                      )}
                    >
                      <Star className="h-4 w-4" fill={fav ? "currentColor" : "none"} />
                    </button>
                    <span className="font-medium text-text-primary">{row.base}</span>
                    <span className="text-xs text-text-secondary">/ USDT</span>
                    <span className="rounded bg-card-hover px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-text-secondary">
                      PERP
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </td>
                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-primary">{formatPrice(row.lastPrice)}</td>
                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-secondary">{formatUsd(row.volume24h)}</td>
                {!compact && <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-secondary">{row.tradeCount}</td>}
                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                  <span className="rounded-md border border-border px-3 py-1 text-xs text-primary hover:bg-card-hover">
                    Trade
                  </span>
                </td>
              </tr>
            );
          })}
        </tbody>
      </table>
      {limit && (data?.length ?? 0) > limit && (
        <div className="border-t border-border p-3 text-center">
          <Link href="/markets" className="text-sm font-medium text-primary hover:text-primary-hover">
            View all markets →
          </Link>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { usePathname, useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { LogOut, Menu, Search, User as UserIcon, X, Zap } from "lucide-react";
import { useAuth } from "@/hooks/useAuth";
import { useBalances } from "@/hooks/useMarketData";
import { useUIStore } from "@/lib/store";
import { EXCHANGE_NAME, NAV_LINKS } from "@/lib/constants";
import { formatUsd, clsx } from "@/lib/utils";

export function Navbar() {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const router = useRouter();
  const { isAuthenticated, logout } = useAuth();
  const { data: balances } = useBalances();
  const mobileNavOpen = useUIStore((s) => s.mobileNavOpen);
  const setMobileNavOpen = useUIStore((s) => s.setMobileNavOpen);

  const usdt = balances?.find((b) => b.symbol === "USDT");

  const handleLogout = () => {
    logout();
    setMobileNavOpen(false);
    router.push("/");
  };

  return (
    <header className="sticky top-0 z-50 border-b border-border bg-background">
      <nav className="mx-auto flex h-14 max-w-[1440px] items-center gap-4 px-4 md:px-6">
        <Link href="/" className="flex items-center gap-2" onClick={() => setMobileNavOpen(false)}>
          <span className="text-lg font-bold tracking-wide text-text-primary">
            {EXCHANGE_NAME}
          </span>
        </Link>

        <div className="ml-6 hidden items-center gap-1 lg:flex">
          {NAV_LINKS.map((link) => {
            const active =
              link.href === "/trade"
                ? pathname.startsWith("/trade") || pathname.startsWith("/futures")
                : pathname === link.href || pathname.startsWith(`${link.href}/`);
            return (
              <Link
                key={link.href}
                href={link.href}
                className={clsx(
                  "rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm transition-colors",
                  active
                    ? "font-semibold text-primary"
                    : "text-text-secondary hover:text-text-primary"
                )}
              >
                {link.label}
              </Link>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        <div className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-3">
          <button
            aria-label="Search"
            className="hidden rounded-md p-2 text-text-secondary transition-colors hover:text-text-primary sm:block"
          >
            <Search className="h-5 w-5" />
          </button>

          {isAuthenticated ? (
            <>
              <div className="hidden items-center gap-2 rounded-md border border-border px-3 py-1.5 md:flex">
                <span className="text-xs text-text-secondary">Balance</span>
                <span className="font-semibold text-text-primary">
                  {formatUsd(usdt?.available ?? 0)}
                </span>
              </div>
              <Link
                href="/profile"
                className="rounded-md border border-border px-3 py-1.5 text-sm text-text-primary transition-colors hover:bg-card"
              >
                Deposit
              </Link>
              <Link
                href="/profile"
                aria-label="Profile"
                className="rounded-full border border-border p-1.5 text-text-primary transition-colors hover:bg-card"
              >
                <UserIcon className="h-5 w-5" />
              </Link>
              <button
                onClick={handleLogout}
                aria-label="Logout"
                className="rounded-md p-2 text-text-secondary transition-colors hover:text-loss"
              >
                <LogOut className="h-5 w-5" />
              </button>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <Link
                href="/login"
                className="hidden rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-sm text-text-primary transition-colors hover:bg-card sm:block"
              >
                Login
              </Link>
              <Link
                href="/register"

                Register
              </Link>
            </>
          )}

          <button
            aria-label="Toggle menu"
            className="rounded-md p-2 text-text-secondary transition-colors hover:text-text-primary lg:hidden"
            onClick={() => setMobileNavOpen(!mobileNavOpen)}
          >
            {mobileNavOpen ? <X className="h-5 w-5" /> : <Menu className="h-5 w-5" />}
          </button>

            className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/60"

              <span className="text-lg font-bold">{EXCHANGE_NAME}</span>
              <button
                aria-label="Close menu"
                className="rounded-md p-2 text-text-secondary hover:text-text-primary"
                onClick={() => setMobileNavOpen(false)}
              >
                <X className="h-5 w-5" />
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
              {NAV_LINKS.map((link) => (
                <Link
                  key={link.href}
                  href={link.href}
                  onClick={() => setMobileNavOpen(false)}
                  className={clsx(
                    "rounded-md px-3 py-2.5 text-sm transition-colors",
                    pathname === link.href
                      ? "bg-card-hover font-semibold text-primary"
                      : "text-text-secondary hover:bg-card-hover hover:text-text-primary"
                  )}
                >
                  {link.label}
                </Link>
              ))}
              {!isAuthenticated && (
                <>
                  <Link
                    href="/login"
                    onClick={() => setMobileNavOpen(false)}
                    className="mt-2 rounded-md border border-border px-3 py-2.5 text-center text-sm text-text-primary"
                  >
                    Login
                  </Link>
                  <Link
                    href="/register"
                    onClick={() => setMobileNavOpen(false)}
                    className="rounded-md bg-primary px-3 py-2.5 text-center text-sm font-semibold text-black"
                  >
                    Register
                  </Link>
                </>
              )}
            </div>
            {isAuthenticated && (
              <button
                onClick={handleLogout}
                className="mt-auto flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-3 py-2.5 text-sm text-loss"
              >
                <LogOut className="h-4 w-4" /> Logout
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </header>
  );
}

import React, { useMemo } from "react";
import { clsx } from "clsx";  // optional – can replace with a simple ternary
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { api } from "@/lib/api";
import type { Orderbook as OrderbookData } from "@/lib/api"; // optional type

const ROWS = 15;

// ─── Helper: format numbers ──────────────────────────────────
const formatPrice = (price: number) => price.toFixed(2);
const formatNumber = (num: number) => num.toFixed(3);

// ─── Main Component ──────────────────────────────────────────
export default function Orderbook({ symbol }: { symbol: string }) {

  const { data } = useQuery({
  queryKey: ["orderbook", symbol],
  queryFn: () => api.getOrderbook(symbol),
  refetchInterval: 1000, // poll every 1s – adjust as needed
});




  const aggregateLevels = (levels: [string, string][]) => {
  const map = new Map<number, number>();
  levels.forEach(([price, qty]) => {
    const p = Number(price);
    const q = Number(qty);
    map.set(p, (map.get(p) || 0) + q);
  });
  return Array.from(map.entries())
    .map(([price, qty]) => ({ price, qty }))
    .sort((a, b) => a.price - b.price);
};

const asks = useMemo(() => {
    const aggregated = aggregateLevels(data?.asks ?? []);
    return aggregated.slice(0, ROWS).reverse();
  }, [data]);

  const bids = useMemo(() => {
    const aggregated = aggregateLevels(data?.bids ?? []);
    return aggregated.sort((a, b) => b.price - a.price).slice(0, ROWS);
  }, [data]);

  

  const askMax = Math.max(...asks.map((l) => l.qty), 0) || 1;
  const bidMax = Math.max(...bids.map((l) => l.qty), 0) || 1;

  const spread =
    asks.length && bids.length
      ? (asks[0]?.price ?? 0) - (bids[0]?.price ?? 0)
      : null;

  // ─── Click handler (dummy) ──────────────────────────────────
  const clickPrice = (price: number, side: "buy" | "sell") => {
    // Replace with your own logic later
    console.log(`Clicked ${side} at ${price}`);
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex h-full flex-col text-[#eaeef4] border border-[#1e232c] rounded-2xl w-full max-w-sm mx-auto shadow-xl">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[#1e232c] px-3 py-2 text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wide text-[#8d93a0]">
        <span>Order Book</span>
        <span>{spread !== null ? formatPrice(spread) : "—"}</span>
      </div>

      {/* Column Headers */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-[9px] text-[#5e6573]">
        <span>Price (USDT)</span>
        <span className="text-right">Amount</span>
        <span className="text-right">Total</span>
      </div>

      {/* Asks (sell side) */}
      <div className="flex flex-col">
        {asks.map((level) => (
          <Row
            key={level.price}
            level={level}
            max={askMax}
            side="ask"
            onClick={() => clickPrice(level.price, "sell")}
          />
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Mid price (best bid) */}
      <div className="px-3 py-2 text-center border-t border-b border-[#1e232c]">
        {bids[0] && (
          <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-[#eaeef4]">
            {formatPrice(bids[0].price)}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Bids (buy side) */}
      <div className="flex flex-col">
        {bids.map((level) => (
          <Row
            key={level.price}
            level={level}
            max={bidMax}
            side="bid"
            onClick={() => clickPrice(level.price, "buy")}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ─── Row Component ───────────────────────────────────────────
function Row({
  level,
  max,
  side,
  onClick,
}: {
  level: { price: number; qty: number };
  max: number;
  side: "bid" | "ask";
  onClick: () => void;
}) {
  const cumulative = level.qty;
  const pct = (cumulative / max) * 100;

  // colour helpers
  const priceColour = side === "ask" ? "text-[#f6465d]" : "text-[#0ecb81]";
  const barColour =
    side === "ask"
      ? "rgba(246,70,93,0.12)"
      : "rgba(14,203,129,0.12)";

  return (
    <button
      onClick={onClick}
      className="relative grid grid-cols-3 items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 text-[9px] transition-colors hover:bg-[#1a1f28]"
    >
      <span
        className="absolute inset-y-0 right-0"
        style={{
          width: `${pct}%`,
          background: barColour,
        }}
      />
      <span className={`relative z-10 text-left ${priceColour}`}>
        {formatPrice(level.price)}
      </span>
      <span className="relative z-10 text-right text-[#eaeef4]">
        {formatNumber(level.qty)}
      </span>
      <span className="relative z-10 text-right text-[#8d93a0]">
        {formatNumber(cumulative)}
      </span>
    </button>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from "react";

// ─── Dummy data ──────────────────────────────────────────────
const DUMMY_BALANCE_USDT = 2377.44372824;
const DUMMY_BALANCE_BTC = 0.05964731;
const DUMMY_MARKET_PRICE = 63381.57; // BTC/USDT price

export default function OrderForm() {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<"limit" | "market" | "stopLimit">("limit");
  const [price, setPrice] = useState<string>("");
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState<string>("");
  const [total, setTotal] = useState<string>("");

  // ─── Calculate total when amount or price changes ──────────
  const handleAmountChange = (value: string) => {
    setAmount(value);
    const numAmount = parseFloat(value);
    const numPrice = parseFloat(price) || DUMMY_MARKET_PRICE;
    if (!isNaN(numAmount) && !isNaN(numPrice)) {
      setTotal((numAmount * numPrice).toFixed(2));
    } else {
      setTotal("");
    }
  };

  const handlePriceChange = (value: string) => {
    setPrice(value);
    const numPrice = parseFloat(value);
    const numAmount = parseFloat(amount);
    if (!isNaN(numAmount) && !isNaN(numPrice)) {
      setTotal((numAmount * numPrice).toFixed(2));
    } else {
      setTotal("");
    }
  };

  // ─── Max buttons ────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleMaxBuy = () => {
    // Buy max with available USDT: amount = balance / price
    const currentPrice = parseFloat(price) || DUMMY_MARKET_PRICE;
    if (currentPrice > 0) {
      const maxAmount = DUMMY_BALANCE_USDT / currentPrice;
      setAmount(maxAmount.toFixed(8));
      setTotal(DUMMY_BALANCE_USDT.toFixed(2));
    }
  };

  const handleMaxSell = () => {
    // Sell max BTC
    setAmount(DUMMY_BALANCE_BTC.toFixed(8));
    const currentPrice = parseFloat(price) || DUMMY_MARKET_PRICE;
    setTotal((DUMMY_BALANCE_BTC * currentPrice).toFixed(2));
  };

  // ─── Fee estimation (0.1% maker/taker) ─────────────────────
  const feeRate = 0.001;
  const estimatedFee = parseFloat(total) * feeRate || 0;

  return (
    <div className="w-full p-2 text-[#eaeef4] overflow-x-auto">
      
      {/* ─── Header: Spot + Fee Level ─── */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
        <span className="text-[9px] font-semibold text-[#eaeef4]">Spot</span>
        <span className="text-[9px] text-[#8d93a0] bg-[#1a1f28] px-2 py-0.5 rounded">% Fee Level</span>
      </div>

      {/* ─── Tabs ─── */}
      <div className="flex border-b text-[9px] border-[#1e232c] mb-2">
        {["Limit", "Market", "Stop Limit"].map((tab) => {
          const key = tab.toLowerCase().replace(" ", "") as "limit" | "market" | "stopLimit";
          return (
            <button
              key={tab}
              className={`px-2 py-1 text-[9px] transition-colors ${
                activeTab === key
                  ? "text-[#eaeef4] border-b-2 border-blue-500"
                  : "text-[#8d93a0] hover:text-[#eaeef4]"
              }`}
              onClick={() => setActiveTab(key)}
            >
              {tab}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      <div className="">
        <div className="flex justify-evenly">
      {/* ─── Price ─── */}
      <div className="mb-3">
        <label className="block text-[9px] text-[#5e6573] uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Price</label>
        <div className="relative">
          <input
            type="text"
            className="w-[23rem]  border border-[#232833] rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-[9px] text-[#eaeef4] outline-none focus:border-blue-500 transition-colors"
            placeholder={activeTab === "market" ? "Market Price" : "0.00"}
            value={activeTab === "market" ? DUMMY_MARKET_PRICE.toFixed(2) : price}
            onChange={(e) => {
              if (activeTab !== "market") handlePriceChange(e.target.value);
            }}
            disabled={activeTab === "market"}
          />
          {activeTab === "market" && (
            <span className="absolute right-3 top-2 text-[9px] text-[#8d93a0]">Market</span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ─── Amount ─── */}
      <div className="mb-3">
        <label className="block text-[9px] text-[#5e6573] uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Amount</label>
        <div className="relative">
          <input
            type="text"
            className="w-[23rem]  border border-[#232833] rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-[9px] text-[#eaeef4] outline-none focus:border-blue-500 transition-colors"
            placeholder="0.00"
            value={amount}
            onChange={(e) => handleAmountChange(e.target.value)}
          />
          <span className="absolute right-3 top-2 text-[9px] text-[#8d93a0]">BTC</span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex justify-between text-[9px] text-[#5e6573] mt-1">
          <span className="text-[9px]">Min: 5 USDT</span>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <button onClick={handleMaxBuy} className="hover:text-[#eaeef4]">Max Buy</button>
            <button onClick={handleMaxSell} className="hover:text-[#eaeef4]">Max Sell</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      </div>

      {/* ─── Total ─── */}
      <div className="flex justify-evenly">
      <div className="mb-3">
        <label className="block text-[9px] text-[#5e6573] uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Total</label>
        <div className="relative">
          <input
            type="text"
            className="w-[23rem]  border border-[#232833] rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-[9px] text-[#eaeef4] outline-none focus:border-blue-500 transition-colors"
            placeholder="0.00"
            value={total}
            onChange={(e) => setTotal(e.target.value)}
          />
          <span className="absolute right-3 top-2 text-[9px] text-[#8d93a0]">USDT</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ─── Balances ─── */}
      <div className="flex gap-2 text-[#8d93a0]  p-3 rounded-lg mt-3 justify-center">
        
        <div className="relative">
          <input
            type="text"
            className="w-[08rem]  border border-[#232833] rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-[9px] text-[#eaeef4] outline-none focus:border-blue-500 transition-colors"
            placeholder="0.00"
            value={total}
            onChange={(e) => setTotal(e.target.value)}
          />
          <span className="absolute right-3 top-2 text-[9px] text-[#8d93a0]">USDT</span>
        </div>
        <div className="relative">
          <input
            type="text"
            className="w-[08rem]  border border-[#232833] rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-[9px] text-[#eaeef4] outline-none focus:border-blue-500 transition-colors"
            placeholder="0.00"
            value={total}
            onChange={(e) => setTotal(e.target.value)}
          />
          <span className="absolute right-3 top-2 text-[9px] text-[#8d93a0]">USDT</span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex">
          <span className="text-[9px] mr-1">Avbl</span>
          <span className="block text-[#eaeef4] text-[9px]">{DUMMY_BALANCE_USDT.toFixed(2)} USDT</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      </div>

      {/* ─── Est. Fee ─── */}
      <div className="flex justify-between text-[9px] text-[#5e6573] mb-2 border-t border-[#1e232c] pt-2">
        <span>Est. Fee</span>
        <span className="text-[#eaeef4] font-mono">{estimatedFee.toFixed(4)} USDT</span>
      </div>

      {/* ─── Buy / Sell Buttons ─── */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 h-[6vh]">
        <button className="bg-[#0ecb81] hover:bg-[#0cb873] text-white font-semibold py-2.5 rounded-sm transition-colors text-[9px]">
          Buy BTC
        </button>
        <button className="bg-[#f6465d] hover:bg-[#d93a4f] text-white font-semibold py-2.5 rounded-sm transition-colors text-[9px]">
          Sell BTC
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="terminal/components/OrderTables.tsx">
"use client";

import { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import {
  usePositions,
  useOrders,
  useFills,
  useCancelOrder,
  useClosePosition,
  useMarkets,
} from "@/hooks/useMarketData";
import { useAuth } from "@/hooks/useAuth";
import { Button, StatusPill, EmptyState, LoadingRow } from "./ui";
import { formatPrice, formatNumber, formatTime, formatUsd, clsx } from "@/lib/utils";

type Tab = "positions" | "open" | "history" | "fills";

export function OrderTables() {
  const { isAuthenticated } = useAuth();
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<Tab>("positions");
  const { data: positions, isLoading: loadingPositions } = usePositions("open");
  const { data: openOrders, isLoading: loadingOpen } = useOrders({ status: "open" });
  const { data: history, isLoading: loadingHistory } = useOrders({ limit: 50 });
  const { data: fills, isLoading: loadingFills } = useFills(50);
  const cancelOrder = useCancelOrder();
  const closePosition = useClosePosition();

  const { data: markets } = useMarkets();
  const symbolOf = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, string>();
    for (const m of markets ?? []) map.set(m.id, m.symbol);
    return (id: string) => map.get(id) ?? id;
  }, [markets]);

  const tabs: Array<{ id: Tab; label: string; count?: number }> = [
    { id: "positions", label: "Positions", count: positions?.length },
    { id: "open", label: "Open Orders", count: openOrders?.length },
    { id: "history", label: "Order History", count: history?.length },
    { id: "fills", label: "Trade History", count: fills?.length },
  ];

  if (!isAuthenticated) {
    return (
      <div className="border-t border-border bg-card p-6 text-center text-sm text-text-secondary">
        <p className="mb-3">Log in to view your positions, orders and trade history.</p>
        <a href="/login" className="rounded-md bg-primary px-4 py-2 font-semibold text-black">
          Log in
        </a>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const loadingMap: Record<Tab, boolean> = {
    positions: loadingPositions,
    open: loadingOpen,
    history: loadingHistory,
    fills: loadingFills,
  };

  return (
    <div className="border-t border-border bg-card">
      <div className="flex gap-1 overflow-x-auto border-b border-border px-2">
        {tabs.map((t) => (
          <button
            key={t.id}
            onClick={() => setTab(t.id)}
            className={clsx(
              "shrink-0 border-b-2 px-4 py-3 text-sm transition-colors",
              tab === t.id
                ? "border-primary font-semibold text-primary"
                : "border-transparent text-text-secondary hover:text-text-primary"
            )}
          >
            {t.label}
            {t.count !== undefined && t.count > 0 && (
              <span className="ml-1.5 rounded bg-card-hover px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs text-text-secondary">
                {t.count}
              </span>
            )}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="overflow-x-auto">
        {loadingMap[tab] ? (
          <LoadingRow />
        ) : tab === "positions" ? (
          <PositionsTable
            positions={positions ?? []}
            symbolOf={symbolOf}
            onClose={(id) => closePosition.mutate(id)}
          />
        ) : tab === "open" ? (
          <OrdersList orders={openOrders ?? []} symbolOf={symbolOf} onCancel={(id) => cancelOrder.mutate(id)} />
        ) : tab === "history" ? (
          <OrdersList orders={history ?? []} symbolOf={symbolOf} />
        ) : (
          <FillsTable fills={fills ?? []} symbolOf={symbolOf} />
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function PositionsTable({
  positions,
  symbolOf,
  onClose,
}: {
  positions: Array<{
    id: string;
    marketId: string;
    side: string;
    quantity: string;
    entryPrice: string;
    markPrice: string;
    liquidationPrice: string;
    margin: string;
    leverage: number;
    realizedPnl: string;
  }>;
  symbolOf: (id: string) => string;
  onClose: (id: string) => void;
}) {
  if (!positions.length) {
    return <EmptyState title="No open positions" hint="Place an order to open a position." />;
  }
  return (
    <table className="w-full min-w-[800px] text-sm">
      <thead>
        <tr className="border-b border-border text-left text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-text-secondary">
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Market</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Side</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Size</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Entry Price</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Mark Price</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Liq. Price</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Margin</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Leverage</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">PnL</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-medium">Action</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        {positions.map((p) => {
          const long = p.side === "long";
          const pnl = (Number(p.markPrice) - Number(p.entryPrice)) * Number(p.quantity) * (long ? 1 : -1);
          return (
            <tr key={p.id} className="border-b border-border hover:bg-card-hover">
              <td className="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-text-primary">
                {symbolOf(p.marketId).split("-")[0]}/USDT
              </td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3">
                <span className={long ? "text-profit" : "text-loss"}>
                  {long ? "Long" : "Short"}
                </span>
              </td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-primary">{formatNumber(p.quantity)}</td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-primary">{formatPrice(p.entryPrice)}</td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-primary">{formatPrice(p.markPrice)}</td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-primary">{formatPrice(p.liquidationPrice)}</td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-primary">{formatUsd(p.margin)}</td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-primary">{p.leverage}×</td>
              <td className={clsx("px-4 py-3", pnl >= 0 ? "text-profit" : "text-loss")}>
                {formatUsd(pnl)}
              </td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                <Button variant="sell" className="px-3 py-1 text-xs" onClick={() => onClose(p.id)}>
                  Close
                </Button>
              </td>
            </tr>
          );
        })}
      </tbody>
    </table>
  );
}

function OrdersList({
  orders,
  symbolOf,
  onCancel,
}: {
  orders: Array<{
    id: string;
    marketId: string;
    side: string;
    orderType: string;
    price: string | null;
    quantity: string;
    filledQuantity: string;
    status: string;
    createdAt: string;
  }>;
  symbolOf: (id: string) => string;
  onCancel?: (id: string) => void;
}) {
  if (!orders.length) {
    return <EmptyState title="No orders" hint="Your orders will appear here." />;
  }
  return (
    <table className="w-full min-w-[800px] text-sm">
      <thead>
        <tr className="border-b border-border text-left text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-text-secondary">
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Market</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Side</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Type</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Price</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Qty</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Filled</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Status</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Time</th>
          {onCancel && <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-medium">Action</th>}
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        {orders.map((o) => {
          const buy = o.side === "buy";
          return (
            <tr key={o.id} className="border-b border-border hover:bg-card-hover">
              <td className="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-text-primary">
                {symbolOf(o.marketId).split("-")[0]}/USDT
              </td>
              <td className={buy ? "px-4 py-3 text-profit" : "px-4 py-3 text-loss"}>
                {buy ? "Buy" : "Sell"}
              </td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 capitalize text-text-primary">{o.orderType}</td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-primary">{o.price ? formatPrice(o.price) : "Market"}</td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-primary">{formatNumber(o.quantity)}</td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-secondary">{formatNumber(o.filledQuantity)}</td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3">
                <StatusPill status={o.status} />
              </td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-secondary">{formatTime(o.createdAt)}</td>
              {onCancel && (
                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                  <Button variant="outline" className="px-3 py-1 text-xs" onClick={() => onCancel(o.id)}>
                    Cancel
                  </Button>
                </td>
              )}
            </tr>
          );
        })}
      </tbody>
    </table>
  );
}

function FillsTable({
  fills,
  symbolOf,
}: {
  fills: Array<{
    id: string;
    marketId: string;
    side: string;
    price: string;
    quantity: string;
    makerFee: string;
    takerFee: string;
    createdAt: string;
  }>;
  symbolOf: (id: string) => string;
}) {
  if (!fills.length) {
    return <EmptyState title="No trades yet" hint="Filled orders will show up here." />;
  }
  return (
    <table className="w-full min-w-[800px] text-sm">
      <thead>
        <tr className="border-b border-border text-left text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-text-secondary">
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Market</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Side</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Price</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Qty</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Fee</th>
          <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Time</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        {fills.map((f) => {
          const buy = f.side === "buy";
          const fee = Number(f.makerFee) + Number(f.takerFee);
          return (
            <tr key={f.id} className="border-b border-border hover:bg-card-hover">
              <td className="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-text-primary">
                {symbolOf(f.marketId).split("-")[0]}/USDT
              </td>
              <td className={buy ? "px-4 py-3 text-profit" : "px-4 py-3 text-loss"}>
                {buy ? "Buy" : "Sell"}
              </td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-primary">{formatPrice(f.price)}</td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-primary">{formatNumber(f.quantity)}</td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-secondary">{formatUsd(fee)}</td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-secondary">{formatTime(f.createdAt)}</td>
            </tr>
          );
        })}
      </tbody>
    </table>
  );
}

  children,

  children: ReactNode;

    <div className={clsx("rounded-lg bg-black/70 shadow-[0_2px_8px_rgba(0,0,0,0.3)]", className)}>

    </div>
  );

type ButtonVariant = "primary" | "sell" | "ghost" | "outline";

export function Button({
  variant = "primary",
  className,
  children,
  ...props
}: ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> & { variant?: ButtonVariant }) {
  const styles: Record<ButtonVariant, string> = {
    primary: "bg-primary text-black font-semibold hover:bg-primary-hover",
    sell: "bg-loss text-white hover:bg-[#D43B52]",
    ghost: "text-text-primary hover:bg-card",
    outline: "border border-border text-text-primary hover:bg-card",
  };
  return (
    <button
      className={clsx(
        "rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm transition-colors disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50",
        styles[variant],
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

export function Input({ className, ...props }: InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>) {
  return (
    <input
      className={clsx(
        "w-full rounded-md border border-border bg-background px-3 py-2 text-text-primary placeholder:text-text-secondary focus:border-primary focus:outline-none",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

<file path="terminal/hooks/useAuth.tsx">
"use client";

import {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useState,
  type ReactNode,
} from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { api, clearToken, getStoredUser, getToken, setToken, storeUser, type AuthUser } from "@/lib/api";

interface AuthContextValue {
  user: AuthUser | null;
  loading: boolean;
  isAuthenticated: boolean;
  login: (token: string, user: AuthUser) => void;
  logout: () => void;
}

const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextValue | null>(null);

export function AuthProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [user, setUser] = useState<AuthUser | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(() => !getToken());
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  useEffect(() => {
    const token = getToken();
    if (!token) return;
    let cancelled = false;
    api
      .me()
      .then((me) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setUser(me);
        storeUser(me);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        clearToken();
        setUser(null);
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  const login = useCallback((token: string, authUser: AuthUser) => {
    setToken(token);
    storeUser(authUser);
    setUser(authUser);
  }, []);

  const logout = useCallback(() => {
    clearToken();
    setUser(null);
    queryClient.clear();
  }, [queryClient]);

  const value = useMemo<AuthContextValue>(
    () => ({ user, loading, isAuthenticated: !!user, login, logout }),
    [user, loading, login, logout]
  );

  return <AuthContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</AuthContext.Provider>;
}

export function useAuth(): AuthContextValue {
  const ctx = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error("useAuth must be used within AuthProvider");
  return ctx;
}

export function useRequireAuth(redirectTo = "/login"): AuthContextValue {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const router = useRouter();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!auth.loading && !auth.isAuthenticated) {
      router.replace(redirectTo);
    }
  }, [auth.loading, auth.isAuthenticated, router, redirectTo]);

  return auth;
}

    queryKey: ["markets"],

      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["balances"] });

      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["orderbook"] });

    mutationFn: (market?: string) => api.cancelAllOrders(market),
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["orders"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["balances"] });
    },
  });
}

export function useClosePosition() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (id: string) => api.closePosition(id),
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["positions"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["orders"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["balances"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["fills"] });
    },
  });
}

export function useMarketCandidates() {
  const markets = useMarkets();
  return markets.data ?? [];
}

  return markets.map((m) => ({ symbol: m.symbol, lastPrice: null }));

<file path="terminal/lib/api.ts">
/**
 * Exchange API Client
 *
 * Typed HTTP client for the Exchange REST API. All monetary values are strings
 * (matching the backend's `numeric(30,8)` format). Authentication is JWT-based
 * with automatic Bearer token injection for protected endpoints.
 *
 * No WebSocket endpoint exists on the backend. All real-time data must be polled.
 */

import { API_BASE_URL, TOKEN_KEY, USER_KEY } from "./constants";

// ─── Error Handling ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** Structured error thrown by every `api.*` method on non-2xx responses. */
export class ApiError extends Error {
  /** HTTP status code. */
  readonly status: number;
  /** Validation issues array from Zod (when `error === "validation_error"`). */
  readonly issues?: unknown;

  constructor(status: number, message: string, issues?: unknown) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "ApiError";
    this.status = status;
    this.issues = issues;
  }
}

// ─── Token / User Persistence ────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** Read the JWT from localStorage. Returns `null` during SSR or when absent. */
export function getToken(): string | null {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;
  return window.localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY);
}

/** Persist the JWT to localStorage. No-op during SSR. */
export function setToken(token: string): void {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  window.localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, token);
}

/** Remove JWT and cached user from localStorage. No-op during SSR. */
export function clearToken(): void {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  window.localStorage.removeItem(TOKEN_KEY);
  window.localStorage.removeItem(USER_KEY);
}

/** Read the cached `AuthUser` from localStorage. Returns `null` during SSR. */
export function getStoredUser(): AuthUser | null {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;
  const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(USER_KEY);
  if (!raw) return null;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw) as AuthUser;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/** Persist an `AuthUser` to localStorage. No-op during SSR. */
export function storeUser(user: AuthUser): void {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  window.localStorage.setItem(USER_KEY, JSON.stringify(user));
}

// ─── Internal Request Engine ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface RequestOptions {
  method?: string;
  body?: unknown;
  auth?: boolean;
  signal?: AbortSignal;
}

/**
 * Core HTTP request helper. All `api.*` methods funnel through here.
 *
 * - Prepends `API_BASE_URL` to the path.
 * - Attaches `Authorization: Bearer <token>` when `auth: true`.
 * - Parses error responses for `{ error, issues }` shape from the backend.
 * - Throws `ApiError` with status code, message, and optional validation issues.
 */
async function request<T>(path: string, options: RequestOptions = {}): Promise<T> {
  const { method = "GET", body, auth = false, signal } = options;
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {};
  if (body !== undefined) headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json";
  if (auth) {
    const token = getToken();
    if (token) headers["Authorization"] = `Bearer ${token}`;
  }
  const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}${path}`, {
    method,
    headers,
    body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body),
    signal,
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    let message = `Request failed (${res.status})`;
    let issues: unknown;
    try {
      const data = (await res.json()) as { error?: string; issues?: unknown };
      if (data.error) message = data.error;
      issues = data.issues;
    } catch {
      // Response body was not JSON — fall through with default message.
    }
    throw new ApiError(res.status, message, issues);
  }
  return (await res.json()) as T;
}

/** Build a URLSearchParams string from an optional record, omitting undefined values. */
function qs(params: Record<string, string | number | undefined>): string {
  const sp = new URLSearchParams();
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(params)) {
    if (v !== undefined && v !== "") sp.set(k, String(v));
  }
  const s = sp.toString();
  return s ? `?${s}` : "";
}

// ─── Public API ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Typed API client for the Exchange REST API.
 *
 * Every method maps 1:1 to a backend endpoint. Return types are inferred
 * from the backend's response shapes. Methods that require authentication
 * pass `{ auth: true }` which auto-attaches the Bearer token from localStorage.
 */
export const api = {
  // ── Health ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Check API health. No auth required.
   * `GET /health`
   */
  health: () => request<HealthResponse>("/health"),

  // ── Auth ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Register a new user account.
   * `POST /auth/register` — Public
   */
  register: (email: string, password: string, name: string) =>
    request<AuthResponse>("/auth/register", {
      method: "POST",
      body: { email, password, name },
    }),

  /**
   * Log in with email and password. Returns JWT and user profile.
   * `POST /auth/login` — Public
   */
  login: (email: string, password: string) =>
    request<AuthResponse>("/auth/login", { method: "POST", body: { email, password } }),

  /**
   * Fetch the current user's profile using the stored JWT.
   * `GET /auth/me` — Auth required
   */
  me: () => request<AuthUser>("/auth/me", { auth: true }),

  /**
   * Log out the current user. Stateless JWT — client must clear token.
   * `POST /auth/logout` — Auth required
   */
  logout: () => request<{ ok: boolean }>("/auth/logout", { method: "POST", auth: true }),

  // ── Markets ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * List all active markets. Returns resolved asset symbols (e.g. `"BTC"`).
   * `GET /markets` — Public
   */
  listMarkets: () => request<{ markets: Market[] }>("/markets"),

  /**
   * Get detailed market info by symbol. Returns raw asset UUIDs
   * (`baseAssetId` / `quoteAssetId`) instead of resolved symbols.
   * `GET /markets/:symbol` — Public
   */
  getMarket: (symbol: string) =>
    request<MarketDetail>(`/markets/${encodeURIComponent(symbol)}`),

  /**
   * Get the current orderbook depth for a symbol.
   * Each level is a `[price, quantity]` string tuple.
   * `GET /markets/:symbol/orderbook?depth=N` — Public
   */
  getOrderbook: (symbol: string, depth = 20) =>
    request<Orderbook>(
      `/markets/${encodeURIComponent(symbol)}/orderbook${qs({ depth })}`
    ),

  /**
   * Get recent public trades for a symbol.
   * `GET /markets/:symbol/trades?limit=N` — Public
   */
  getTrades: (symbol: string, limit = 50) =>
    request<{ symbol: string; trades: Fill[] }>(
      `/markets/${encodeURIComponent(symbol)}/trades${qs({ limit })}`
    ),

  /**
   * Get 24h ticker data (last price, volume, trade count) for a symbol.
   * `lastPrice` is `null` when no trades exist.
   * `GET /markets/:symbol/ticker` — Public
   */
  getTicker: (symbol: string) =>
    request<Ticker>(`/markets/${encodeURIComponent(symbol)}/ticker`),

  // ── Balances ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * List all balances for the authenticated user.
   * `GET /balances` — Auth required
   */
  getBalances: () => request<{ balances: Balance[] }>("/balances", { auth: true }),

  /**
   * Deposit an asset (simulated for testing).
   * `POST /balances/deposit` — Auth required
   */
  deposit: (asset: string, amount: string) =>
    request<BalanceChange>("/balances/deposit", {
      method: "POST",
      body: { asset, amount },
      auth: true,
    }),

  /**
   * Withdraw an asset (deducts from available balance).
   * `POST /balances/withdraw` — Auth required
   */
  withdraw: (asset: string, amount: string) =>
    request<BalanceChange>("/balances/withdraw", {
      method: "POST",
      body: { asset, amount },
      auth: true,
    }),

  // ── Orders ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Place a new order. For `limit` orders, `price` is required.
   * Returns the created order. If `clientOrderId` is reused, returns the
   * existing order with `idempotent: true`.
   *
   * Recommended payload shape: `PlaceOrderPayload`. The parameter accepts
   * `Record<string, unknown>` for backward compatibility with existing callers.
   *
   * `POST /orders` — Auth required
   */
  placeOrder: (payload: PlaceOrderPayload | Record<string, unknown>) =>
    request<{ order: Order; idempotent: boolean }>("/orders", {
      method: "POST",
      body: payload,
      auth: true,
    }),

  /**
   * List orders with optional filters. Results are ordered by `created_at DESC`.
   * `GET /orders?status=&market=&limit=` — Auth required
   */
  listOrders: (params: { status?: string; market?: string; limit?: number } = {}) => {
    const q = qs({
      status: params.status,
      market: params.market,
      limit: params.limit,
    });
    return request<{ orders: Order[] }>(`/orders${q}`, { auth: true });
  },

  /**
   * Get a single order by ID.
   * `GET /orders/:id` — Auth required
   */
  getOrder: (id: string) =>
    request<Order>(`/orders/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { auth: true }),

  /**
   * Cancel a single open order by ID.
   * `DELETE /orders/:id` — Auth required
   */
  cancelOrder: (id: string) =>
    request<{ orderId: string; status: "canceled" }>(
      `/orders/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`,
      { method: "DELETE", auth: true }
    ),

  /**
   * Cancel all open orders, optionally filtered by market symbol.
   * `DELETE /orders?market=` — Auth required
   */
  cancelAllOrders: (market?: string) => {
    const q = qs({ market });
    return request<{ canceled: number }>(`/orders${q}`, {
      method: "DELETE",
      auth: true,
    });
  },

  // ── Positions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * List positions filtered by status (default `"open"`).
   * `GET /positions?status=` — Auth required
   */
  listPositions: (status = "open") =>
    request<{ positions: Position[] }>(`/positions${qs({ status })}`, { auth: true }),

  /**
   * Get a single position by ID.
   * `GET /positions/:id` — Auth required
   */
  getPosition: (id: string) =>
    request<Position>(`/positions/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { auth: true }),

  /**
   * Close an open position by creating a reduce-only market order in the
   * opposite direction.
   * `POST /positions/:id/close` — Auth required
   */
  closePosition: (id: string) =>
    request<{ order: Order }>(
      `/positions/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/close`,
      { method: "POST", auth: true }
    ),

  // ── Fills ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * List the user's trade fills (as maker or taker).
   * Ordered by `created_at DESC`.
   * `GET /fills?limit=` — Auth required
   */
  listFills: (limit = 50) =>
    request<{ fills: Fill[] }>(`/fills${qs({ limit })}`, { auth: true }),

  // ── Funding ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * List the user's funding payment history.
   * `GET /funding/payments?limit=` — Auth required
   */
  listFundingPayments: (limit = 100) =>
    request<{ payments: FundingPayment[] }>(
      `/funding/payments${qs({ limit })}`,
      { auth: true }
    ),
};

import type { Candle } from "@/components/CandlestickChart";
import type { Fill } from "@/lib/api";

export const CANDLE_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 60;

export function buildCandles(trades: Fill[], interval = CANDLE_INTERVAL_SECONDS): Candle[] {
  const buckets = new Map<number, Candle>();

  for (const trade of trades) {
    const ts = new Date(trade.createdAt).getTime() / 1000;
    if (Number.isNaN(ts)) continue;
    const bucket = Math.floor(ts / interval) * interval;
    const price = Number(trade.price);
    const existing = buckets.get(bucket);
    if (!existing) {
      buckets.set(bucket, {
        time: bucket,
        open: price,
        high: price,
        low: price,
        close: price,
      });
      continue;
    }
    existing.high = Math.max(existing.high, price);
    existing.low = Math.min(existing.low, price);
    existing.close = price;
  }

  return Array.from(buckets.values())
    .sort((a, b) => a.time - b.time)
    .map((c) => ({ ...c, high: c.high, low: c.low }));
}

import { create } from "zustand";

export type OrderSide = "buy" | "sell";
export type OrderType = "limit" | "market";

interface UIState {
  selectedMarket: string;
  orderSide: OrderSide;
  orderType: OrderType;
  price: string;
  amount: string;
  leverage: string;
  mobileNavOpen: boolean;
  favorites: string[];
  setSelectedMarket: (market: string) => void;
  setOrderSide: (side: OrderSide) => void;
  setOrderType: (type: OrderType) => void;
  setPrice: (price: string) => void;
  setAmount: (amount: string) => void;
  setLeverage: (leverage: string) => void;
  setMobileNavOpen: (open: boolean) => void;
  toggleFavorite: (symbol: string) => void;
  resetOrderForm: () => void;
}

const FAVORITES_KEY = "exchange_favorites";

function loadFavorites(): string[] {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return [];
  try {
    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(FAVORITES_KEY);
    return raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as string[]) : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function saveFavorites(favorites: string[]): void {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  window.localStorage.setItem(FAVORITES_KEY, JSON.stringify(favorites));
}

export const useUIStore = create<UIState>((set) => ({
  selectedMarket: "BTC-USDT-PERP",
  orderSide: "buy",
  orderType: "limit",
  price: "",
  amount: "",
  leverage: "10",
  mobileNavOpen: false,
  favorites: loadFavorites(),
  setSelectedMarket: (market) => set({ selectedMarket: market }),
  setOrderSide: (side) => set({ orderSide: side }),
  setOrderType: (type) => set({ orderType: type }),
  setPrice: (price) => set({ price }),
  setAmount: (amount) => set({ amount }),
  setLeverage: (leverage) => set({ leverage }),
  setMobileNavOpen: (open) => set({ mobileNavOpen: open }),
  toggleFavorite: (symbol) =>
    set((state) => {
      const has = state.favorites.includes(symbol);
      const favorites = has
        ? state.favorites.filter((s) => s !== symbol)
        : [...state.favorites, symbol];
      saveFavorites(favorites);
      return { favorites };
    }),
  resetOrderForm: () => set({ price: "", amount: "" }),
}));

export function formatPrice(value: string | number | null | undefined, decimals = 2): string {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "") return "—";
  const num = Number(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(num)) return "—";
  return num.toLocaleString("en-US", {
    minimumFractionDigits: decimals,
    maximumFractionDigits: decimals,
  });
}

export function formatNumber(value: string | number | null | undefined, decimals = 4): string {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "") return "—";
  const num = Number(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(num)) return "—";
  return num.toLocaleString("en-US", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 0,
    maximumFractionDigits: decimals,
  });
}

export function formatUsd(value: string | number | null | undefined): string {
  const num = Number(value ?? 0);
  return num.toLocaleString("en-US", {
    style: "currency",
    currency: "USD",
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  });
}

export function formatPercent(value: string | number | null | undefined): string {
  const num = Number(value ?? 0);
  const sign = num > 0 ? "+" : "";
  return `${sign}${num.toFixed(2)}%`;
}

export function formatTime(value: string | Date | null | undefined): string {
  if (!value) return "—";
  const d = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return "—";
  return d.toLocaleString("en-US", {
    month: "short",
    day: "numeric",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
    second: "2-digit",
  });
}

export function clsx(...classes: Array<string | false | null | undefined>): string {
  return classes.filter(Boolean).join(" ");
}

export function isPositive(value: string | number | null | undefined): boolean {
  return Number(value ?? 0) >= 0;
}

export function marketBase(symbol: string): string {
  const base = symbol.split("-")[0];
  return base ?? symbol;
}

export function marketQuote(symbol: string): string {
  return symbol.split("-")[1] ?? "USDT";
}

export function truncateMiddle(id: string, len = 8): string {
  if (!id || id.length <= len * 2) return id;
  return `${id.slice(0, len)}…${id.slice(-len)}`;
}

<file path="terminal/lib/websocket.ts">
import { create } from "zustand";
import { WS_URL } from "./constants";

export type ConnectionStatus = "connecting" | "connected" | "disconnected" | "unavailable";

interface ConnectionState {
  status: ConnectionStatus;
  lastMessageAt: number | null;
  setStatus: (status: ConnectionStatus) => void;
}

export const useConnection = create<ConnectionState>((set) => ({
  status: "disconnected",
  lastMessageAt: null,
  setStatus: (status) =>
    set((state) => ({
      status,
      lastMessageAt: status === "connected" ? Date.now() : state.lastMessageAt,
    })),
}));

let socket: WebSocket | null = null;
let reconnectTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
let attempts = 0;

const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3;

export function connectSocket(): void {
  const { status, setStatus } = useConnection.getState();
  if (socket || status === "unavailable") return;

  setStatus("connecting");
  let ws: WebSocket;
  try {
    ws = new WebSocket(WS_URL);
  } catch {
    setStatus("unavailable");
    return;
  }
  socket = ws;

  ws.onopen = () => {
    attempts = 0;
    setStatus("connected");
  };

  ws.onmessage = () => {
    setStatus("connected");
  };

  ws.onerror = () => {
    // Backend has no WebSocket endpoint; degrade to polling.
    setStatus("unavailable");
  };

  ws.onclose = () => {
    socket = null;
    setStatus("disconnected");
    if (attempts < MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
      attempts += 1;
      reconnectTimer = setTimeout(connectSocket, 2000 * attempts);
    } else {
      setStatus("unavailable");
    }
  };
}

export function disconnectSocket(): void {
  if (reconnectTimer) clearTimeout(reconnectTimer);
  reconnectTimer = null;
  if (socket) {
    socket.onclose = null;
    socket.close();
    socket = null;
  }
  useConnection.getState().setStatus("disconnected");
}
